courseHook.unitTitle: Academic Prepositional Collocations 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The archival documents reveal that the medieval guild masters met ___ to deliberate on apprentices' guild examinations.
options: annually on an annual basis every year
each year on an annual cycle
translation:
【題幹精譯】檔案文獻揭示，中世紀行會大師們「每年」定期集會，以審查學徒的行會資格檢定考試。
【選項列表】A. annually on an annual basis every year  B. annually every single year  C. annually  D. each year on an annual cycle
coreConcept: annually 已包含「每年」之意，其他選項疊床架屋語意重複 (on an annual basis every year 等均為贅詞)，簡潔選 annually。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「annually」。學術文風簡潔性：剔除重複冗詞，單選副詞 annually。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The laboratory technicians confirmed that the two chemical solutions were ___ in chemical composition and molecular structure.
options: completely identical and exactly the same
identical copies of each other with no differences
translation:
【題幹精譯】實驗室檢驗員證實，這兩種化學溶液在化學組成與分子結構上「完全相同」。
【選項列表】A. completely identical and exactly the same  B. identically duplicate twins  C. identical copies of each other with no differences  D. identical
coreConcept: identical 本身即代表「完全相同」，後方再加 exactly the same 或 no differences 皆屬語意重複之贅病，選 identical。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「identical」。簡潔性原則：identical 無需再加 exactly the same 等贅詞修飾。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The archeological team unearthed an ancient wall that had been ___ into three separate fragments.
translation:
【題幹精譯】考古隊挖掘出了一道早已「斷裂破裂成」三個獨立碎塊的古代城牆殘垣。
【選項列表】A. broken  B. broken apart into pieces  C. broken down into split pieces  D. broken and smashed apart
coreConcept: broken 已清楚表達破碎狀態，其他選項堆砌 apart into pieces 均為冗言贅字，最精煉純粹選 broken。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「broken」。簡潔選詞：broken 符合學術行文乾淨凝練標準。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The research paper concluded with a brief ___ of the experimental methodology.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該研究論文以對實驗方法論的簡短「總結摘要」作為收尾結語。
【選項列表】A. summary recapitulation  B. summary  C. summary that summarized the findings  D. brief summary repetition
coreConcept: summary 本身即是總結，若使用 summary that summarized 或 summary recapitulation 均屬同義反覆之語病，選 summary。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「summary」。剔除同義贅述：單一名詞 summary 最具學術規範。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The newly passed urban zoning ordinance will ___ in the upcoming calendar month.
options: take effect and become operational and functional
take active legal effect into practical action
take operative legal effect starting to work
translation:
【題幹精譯】這項新審議通過的城市分區規劃法規，將於即將到來的下個月份「正式生效施行」。
【選項列表】A. take effect and become operational and functional  B. take active legal effect into practical action  C. take effect  D. take operative legal effect starting to work
coreConcept: take effect 為法律與學術標準固定詞組，後續補充 become operational 等均為冗餘贅詞，選 take effect。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「take effect」。商務與法律簡練原則：精簡片語 take effect。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The historical biographer noted that the statesman was a ___ speaker who swayed parliaments with his impassioned rhetoric.
options: persuasive speaker capable of convincing people
persuasive orator who persuaded listeners effectively
translation:
【題幹精譯】歷史傳記作家指出，該政治家是一位「極具說服力的」演說家，常以其慷慨激昂的雄辯之詞折服國會議員。
【選項列表】A. persuasive speaker capable of convincing people  B. persuasive orator who persuaded listeners effectively  C. convincing speaker full of persuasion  D. persuasive
coreConcept: persuasive（具說服力的）之後再加 capable of convincing people 屬於典型的語意重疊贅詞，單用 persuasive 最為俐落。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「persuasive」。定語簡練原則：persuasive 單詞即精確表達說服力。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The astrophysicist explained that the celestial body had ___ around the supermassive black hole.
options: completed a circular round orbit in a circle
orbited around in a full complete 360-degree circle
finished a revolving complete cycle of orbit
translation:
【題幹精譯】天體物理學家解釋說，該天體早已圍繞超大質量黑洞「完成了一次完整公轉軌道」。
【選項列表】A. completed an orbit  B. completed a circular round orbit in a circle  C. orbited around in a full complete 360-degree circle  D. finished a revolving complete cycle of orbit
coreConcept: completed an orbit 簡明精準，其他選項將 circular、round、in a circle 等重複堆砌，均為贅語，選 completed an orbit。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「completed an orbit」。科學論文簡約原則：completed an orbit 精準無冗詞。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The committee members unanimously reached a ___ on the budget allocation.
options: unanimous consensus of agreement where everyone agreed
consensus wherein all members were in total agreement
translation:
【題幹精譯】委員會全體委員針對預算分配方案全體一致地「達成了共識」。
【選項列表】A. unanimous consensus of agreement where everyone agreed  B. consensus  C. consensus of unified mutual agreement  D. consensus wherein all members were in total agreement
coreConcept: consensus（共識）本身即蘊含眾人一致同意之意，再添 of agreement where everyone agreed 等純屬廢話冗詞，選 consensus。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「consensus」。名詞規範：單用 consensus 避免語意反覆。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The botanical expedition discovered an indigenous plant species that was ___ to the island.
options: unique and found nowhere else in the world
translation:
【題幹精譯】該植物學考察隊發現了一種該島嶼所「獨有的」特有原生植物物種。
【選項列表】A. unique and found nowhere else in the world  B. uniquely native and totally singular  C. unique  D. exclusive and solely unique
coreConcept: unique to the island 意為「該島特有的」，再贅述 found nowhere else 或 totally singular 皆犯了贅字之大忌，選 unique。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 獨特的特有的獨一無二的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「unique」。形容詞精確度：unique to 已完整表達獨特性。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy
prompt: The company decided to ___ its older mainframe computing systems next quarter.
options: retire and phase out and discontinue completely
permanently retire and stop using forever
translation:
【題幹精譯】該跨國公司拍板決定，將於下個季度正式「汰除淘汰」其舊型大型主機電腦系統。
【選項列表】A. retire and phase out and discontinue completely  B. permanently retire and stop using forever  C. retire away into obsolescence  D. retire
coreConcept: retire 在科技軟硬體術語中即表示「退役、停用汰除」，其他選項之 phase out and discontinue 疊床架屋，選 retire。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 大型主機中央處理系統

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「retire」。動詞精練原則：單一專業動詞 retire 取代冗長贅語。

courseHook.unitTitle: Style & Conciseness: Eliminating Redundancy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'These subterranean networks, known as mycorrhizae, facilitate mutualistic resource exchange' be placed in the paragraph? 
[1] Plants do not exist as isolated biological entities in forest ecosystems. [2] Beneath the soil, their roots intertwine intimately with vast webs of fungal hyphae. [3] In exchange for photosynthetic carbohydrates, the fungi supply nitrogen and phosphorus. [4] This hidden cooperation challenges traditional competitive models of evolution.
translation:
【題幹精譯】篇章邏輯銜接題：句子指出「這些被稱為菌根的地下網絡促進了互利資源交換」，其中 'These subterranean networks' 明顯指涉前一句中的 'vast webs of fungal hyphae'（地下真菌菌絲網絡），且後一句緊接著解釋資源交換細節 (In exchange for carbohydrates... fungi supply nitrogen)。因此最理想位置在句 2 之後。
【選項列表】A. After sentence 2  B. After sentence 1  C. After sentence 3  D. After sentence 4
coreConcept: 指代詞銜接：These subterranean networks 承接句 2 的 webs of fungal hyphae，引出句 3 的資源交換。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「After sentence 2」。最佳銜接位置選 After sentence 2。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'However, isotopic analysis of preserved dentition has overturned this pastoral assumption' be inserted? 
[1] For decades, anthropologists assumed that early hominids in the savannah consumed an exclusively frugivorous diet. [2] Microscopic microwear patterns on fossilized molars initially seemed to support this hypothesis. [3] Instead, the carbon isotope ratios demonstrate heavy reliance on tough C4 grasses and roots. [4] Consequently, our evolutionary ancestors were far more versatile opportunists than previously imagined.
translation:
【題幹精譯】語意轉折插入題：句子以 However 開頭，指出「對保存牙齒的同位素分析推翻了這項食果假說」。句 1-2 描述過去的食果假說及其初步支持證據；句 3 以 Instead 開頭直接說明同位素分析揭示的真正草食根莖飲食。因此該轉折句必須置於句 2 之後、句 3 之前。
【選項列表】A. After sentence 1  B. After sentence 2  C. After sentence 3  D. After sentence 4
coreConcept: 轉折句銜接：推翻句 1-2 的傳統假說，引導句 3 的 Instead 實證數據，選 After sentence 2。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「After sentence 2」。最佳銜接位選 After sentence 2。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'This gravitational anomaly, colloquially dubbed the Great Attractor, exerts an irresistible pull' be positioned? 
[1] Modern astrophysicists mapping the local universe detected an unexpected cosmic movement. [2] Tens of thousands of galaxies, including our own Milky Way, are drifting toward a specific region in the Centaurus cluster. [3] Obscured behind the dust of the Zone of Avoidance, its precise physical composition remains an enigma. [4] Future infrared and radio surveys aim to pierce this interstellar veil.
translation:
【題幹精譯】指涉語流暢度分析：待插入句子以 'This gravitational anomaly'（這處引力異常體，俗稱巨引源）起手，精確對應句 2 中成千上萬星系正朝向半人馬座方向飄移的宏觀引力現象；隨後句 3 中的代名詞 'its precise physical composition' 剛好指稱這座巨引源。故最佳位置在句 2 之後。
【選項列表】A. After sentence 1  B. After sentence 3  C. After sentence 2  D. After sentence 4
coreConcept: 指涉銜接：承接句 2 的星系漂移現象，引導句 3 的 its physical composition，選 After sentence 2。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「After sentence 2」。最佳句子排序選 After sentence 2。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'Without these specialized physiological adaptations, deep dives would inevitably cause lethal decompression sickness' be placed? 
[1] Marine mammals like the sperm whale descend to crushing depths exceeding two thousand meters. [2] To survive, they collapse their lungs intentionally, expelling air to avoid nitrogen absorption into the bloodstream. [3] Furthermore, high concentrations of myoglobin in their skeletal muscles store vast quantities of oxygen. [4] These combined mechanisms allow them to hunt giant squid in the abyssal zone for over an hour.
translation:
【題幹精譯】邏輯總結功能句插入：待插入句 'Without these specialized physiological adaptations...'（如果沒有這些專門的生理適應機制，深潛將引發致命潛水夫病）。句 2 提到肺部塌陷，句 3 提到肌紅蛋白儲氧，兩者合稱為 these adaptations；且句 4 緊接著說 These combined mechanisms allow them...。因此置於句 3 之後最能起到承上啟下的反面強調作用。
【選項列表】A. After sentence 1  B. After sentence 2  C. After sentence 4  D. After sentence 3
coreConcept: 生理機制反面強調句：置於兩種適應機制 (句2, 句3) 描述之後，選 After sentence 3。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「After sentence 3」。最佳插入位置選 After sentence 3。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'Chief among these archival treasures is a parchment manuscript dating to 1215' be inserted? 
[1] The British Library houses some of the most significant historical documents in the Western world. [2] Scholars from around the globe travel to London to inspect its rare codices and cartographic scrolls. [3] Bearing the royal seal of King John, the Magna Carta established the foundational constitutional principle that even monarchs are subject to the law. [4] It remains an enduring symbol of liberty across modern democracies.
translation:
【題幹精譯】概念引導句銜接：待插入句提到「在這些檔案珍藏中，首屈一指的便是一份可追溯至 1215 年的羊皮紙手抄文獻」。句 2 提到全球學者前來查閱古抄本卷軸；句 3 緊接著描述「蓋有約翰國王御璽的大憲章 (Magna Carta) 奠定了君權受法律約束之憲政原則」。因此該句為句 3 大憲章的出場合理鋪陳引介，必須插在句 2 之後。
【選項列表】A. After sentence 2  B. After sentence 1  C. After sentence 3  D. After sentence 4
coreConcept: 文獻引入句：承接句 2 的文獻收藏，為句 3 的 Magna Carta 正式出場作鋪陳，選 After sentence 2。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「After sentence 2」。最佳句位銜接選 After sentence 2。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'This extraordinary navigational precision, known as magnetoreception, relies on specialized cryptochrome proteins in their retinas' be placed in the paragraph? 
[1] European robins undertake perilous transcontinental migrations every autumn. [2] Even when deprived of celestial landmarks like the stars and sun, they orient themselves unerringly toward their wintering grounds. [3] These light-activated biomolecules detect subtle quantum shifts in Earth’s geomagnetic field. [4] Armed with this internal compass, the songbirds navigate pitch-black nocturnal skies with ease.
translation:
【題幹精譯】篇章邏輯銜接題：待插入句提到「這種被稱為磁感應的非凡導航精準度，仰賴視網膜中專門的隱花色素蛋白」。句 2 描述在失去日月星辰地標時仍能無誤定向；句 3 緊接著以 'These light-activated biomolecules' 指稱待插入句中的 'cryptochrome proteins'。因此該句必須插在句 2 之後、句 3 之前！
【選項列表】A. After sentence 1  B. After sentence 2  C. After sentence 3  D. After sentence 4
coreConcept: 指代鏈條銜接：承接句 2 的定向現象，引導句 3 的 These biomolecules，選 After sentence 2。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「After sentence 2」。最佳銜接位選 After sentence 2。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'Consequently, the enzyme remains locked in an inactive conformation until the target hormone binds' be inserted? 
[1] Cellular signal transduction pathways depend on intricate molecular switches. [2] In the resting state, regulatory subunits physically obstruct the catalytic pocket of protein kinase A. [3] This spatial blockade prevents premature phosphorylation of downstream metabolic targets. [4] Once liberated by cyclic AMP, the kinase initiates a rapid cascade of enzymatic reactions.
translation:
【題幹精譯】因果承接功能句分析：待插入句以 Consequently 開頭，說明「因此該酵素始終被鎖定在未激活構象中，直到目標荷爾蒙結合為止」。句 2 描述亞基在空間上阻擋催化活性口袋；句 3 說明這種空間阻斷防範了提前磷酸化。待插入句作為對這種抑制封鎖狀態的總結結論，最適合置於句 3 之後，引導句 4 的一旦釋放之後的連鎖反應。
【選項列表】A. After sentence 1  B. After sentence 2  C. After sentence 3  D. After sentence 4
coreConcept: 因果總結銜接：接在空間阻斷效應 (句3) 之後作總結，引導句 4 的激酶活化，選 After sentence 3。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「After sentence 3」。最佳插入位選 After sentence 3。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'Chief among these volatile compounds is geosmin, an organic molecule synthesized by actinobacteria' be positioned? 
[1] The distinct, earthy scent that accompanies the first rainfall after a prolonged dry spell is termed petrichor. [2] When raindrops strike dry, porous soil, they trap micro-bubbles of air that shoot upward as tiny aerosolized droplets. [3] These microscopic mist particles carry a complex mixture of aromatic plant oils and bacterial secretions into the air. [4] Human olfactory receptors are exquisitely sensitive to this chemical, capable of detecting it at concentrations in parts per trillion.
translation:
【題幹精譯】概念具象化銜接題：待插入句指出「在這些揮發性化合物中，首要核心成分便是土臭素 (geosmin)，一種由放線菌合成的有機分子」。句 3 提到雨滴微粒攜帶『芳香植物油與細菌分泌物的複雜混合物』；句 4 緊接著說『人類嗅覺受體對這種化學物質 (this chemical) 異常敏感』。待插入句正好承接句 3 的化合物混合物，並引導句 4 的 this chemical！
【選項列表】A. After sentence 1  B. After sentence 2  C. After sentence 4  D. After sentence 3
coreConcept: 指代名詞鏈接：承接句 3 的 volatile compounds，引導句 4 的 this chemical，選 After sentence 3。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「After sentence 3」。最佳位置選 After sentence 3。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'However, radiometric dating of the surrounding volcanic tuff challenged this simplistic timeline' be inserted in the paragraph? 
[1] Early geologists assumed that the fossil-bearing strata at Olduvai Gorge were deposited uniformly over ten million years. [2] The gradual accumulation of sedimentary sandstone seemed consistent with traditional Lyellian gradualism. [3] The isotopic potassium-argon ratios demonstrated that the entire geological sequence had accumulated in less than two million years. [4] This condensed chronology forced paleontologists to compress their models of early hominid morphological evolution.
translation:
【題幹精譯】轉折推進功能句分析：待插入句以 However 開頭，指出「然而對周圍火山凝灰岩的放射性同位素定年法挑戰了這一過度簡化的時間表」。句 1-2 描述傳統地質學家認為沉積過程耗時一千萬年；待插入句推翻該假說；句 3 緊接著給出同位素定年證明整個序列不到兩百萬年；句 4 總結這迫使學者壓縮人類演化時鐘。因此該轉折句必須插在句 2 之後、句 3 之前！
【選項列表】A. After sentence 2  B. After sentence 1  C. After sentence 3  D. After sentence 4
coreConcept: 轉折句定位：接在傳統千萬年假說 (句2) 之後，引出兩百萬年定年證據 (句3)，選 After sentence 2。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 放射線測定的放射性同位素的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「After sentence 2」。最佳句序選 After sentence 2。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow
prompt:
Where should the sentence 'This radical redistribution of political power, known as ostracism, served as an institutional bulwark against authoritarian tyranny' be placed? 
[1] Classical Athenian democracy developed unique legal mechanisms to preserve civic equilibrium. [2] Once a year, citizens gathered in the agora to scratch the name of any overly dominant politician onto broken pottery shards. [3] Any public figure who received a plurality of votes was immediately cast into exile from Attica for ten years. [4] By neutralizing potential despots preemptively, the polis protected its fragile constitutional stability.
translation:
【題幹精譯】制度總結命名功能句分析：待插入句指出「這種激進的政治權力再分配——被稱為陶片放逐制——充當了防禦專制暴政的制度性堡壘」。句 2 描述在陶片上刻上強權政客的名字，句 3 描述得票最多者即刻被放逐流放雅典十年；待插入句對這套放逐投票體制作出概念命名 (known as ostracism) 與制度定性；句 4 緊接著說 By neutralizing despots preemptively, the polis protected...。故最佳位置在句 3 之後！
【選項列表】A. After sentence 1  B. After sentence 3  C. After sentence 2  D. After sentence 4
coreConcept: 概念定性銜接：接在放逐十年的完整程序描述 (句3) 之後，引出防禦暴政的結論 (句4)，選 After sentence 3。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「After sentence 3」。最佳銜接位選 After sentence 3。

courseHook.unitTitle: Sentence Placement & Cohesive Flow 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: The historian writes: 'While King James I commissioned the 1611 English translation of the Bible partly to standardize liturgical readings across the realm, his unspoken imperative was to curb the subversive, anti-monarchical marginal annotations found in the immensely popular Geneva Bible.' It can be reasonably inferred from this passage that the author believes:
options: King James I had no genuine personal interest in religious translation or Christian doctrine
the Geneva Bible was universally rejected by British Protestant congregations in the seventeenth century
the King James Bible served an ideological agenda aimed at reinforcing royal political authority
seventeenth-century English readers completely ignored marginal commentary in religious books
translation:
【題幹精譯】語用推論題：作者指出詹姆士一世欽定版聖經表面上是統一度量儀式，但未言明的隱含目的在於遏制受歡迎的日內瓦聖經中反君主專制的旁註評論。由此可合理解讀出：作者認為欽定版聖經肩負著維護王室政治威權的意識形態目的。
【選項列表】A. King James I had no genuine personal interest in religious translation or Christian doctrine  B. the Geneva Bible was universally rejected by British Protestant congregations in the seventeenth century  C. the King James Bible served an ideological agenda aimed at reinforcing royal political authority  D. seventeenth-century English readers completely ignored marginal commentary in religious books
coreConcept: 文本深度推論：遏制反君主言論 -> 具有維護王權的意識形態意圖 (ideological agenda reinforcing royal authority)。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 當務之急緊迫命令必要條件

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「the King James Bible served an ideological agenda aimed at reinforcing royal political authority」。推論選項對應 served an ideological agenda aimed at reinforcing royal authority。

courseHook.unitTitle: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: A scholar notes: 'In her philosophical treaties, Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz couched her radical defense of women’s intellectual autonomy in deferential theological humility, repeatedly apologizing for her presumption even as she systematically dismantled patriarchal ecclesiastical dogma.' This passage most directly suggests that Sor Juana:
options: genuinely believed that women were intellectually inferior to male clerics in biblical interpretation
abandoned her scholarly pursuits as soon as religious authorities questioned her writings
was unaware that her theological writings challenged the prevailing orthodoxies of the Spanish Viceroyalty
tactically adopted conventional self-deprecating modesty to protect herself from institutional inquisitorial censorship
translation:
【題幹精譯】人文歷史推論題：修女胡安娜在論辯女性求學權利時，將激進論述包裝在虔誠謙遜的自我貶抑文字中，一邊道歉一邊系統性瓦解父權教條。這強烈暗示她：策略性地運用傳統謙卑姿態，旨在保護自己免遭教會宗教裁判所的查禁迫害。
【選項列表】A. genuinely believed that women were intellectually inferior to male clerics in biblical interpretation  B. abandoned her scholarly pursuits as soon as religious authorities questioned her writings  C. was unaware that her theological writings challenged the prevailing orthodoxies of the Spanish Viceroyalty  D. tactically adopted conventional self-deprecating modesty to protect herself from institutional inquisitorial censorship
coreConcept: 修辭動機推論：謙恭表象與激進實質反差 -> 戰術性自保策略 (tactically adopted modesty to protect from censorship)。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「tactically adopted conventional self-deprecating modesty to protect herself from institutional inquisitorial censorship」。推論選項對應 tactically adopted modesty to protect from censorship。

courseHook.unitTitle: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: The author remarks: 'The rapid industrialization of nineteenth-century Manchester produced unparalleled mechanical wealth, yet the life expectancy of factory laborers hovered below twenty-five years, prompting Alexis de Tocqueville to observe that from this foul drain the greatest stream of human industry flows out to fertilize the whole world, but here human nature is degraded and reduced to brutality.' What underlying premise informs Tocqueville’s observation?
options: The spectacular macroeconomic progress of industrial capitalism was bought at the cost of catastrophic human exploitation.
Manchester was the only city in Europe to benefit from the advent of the steam engine.
Factory laborers in Britain universally refused to organize trade unions to ameliorate their conditions.
Technological progress inevitably elevates the moral and physical well-being of the working classes.
translation:
【題幹精譯】隱含前提推論題：托克維爾評論「從這條污穢骯髒的陰溝中，人類工業的最偉大洪流奔湧而出滋潤全世界，然而在此人類天性卻遭到徹底貶低退化為野蠻殘酷」。這段話背後的隱含核心前提是：工業資本主義令人炫目的宏觀經濟繁榮，是以災難性的人性殘酷剝削為巨大代價換取來的。
【選項列表】A. The spectacular macroeconomic progress of industrial capitalism was bought at the cost of catastrophic human exploitation.  B. Manchester was the only city in Europe to benefit from the advent of the steam engine.  C. Factory laborers in Britain universally refused to organize trade unions to ameliorate their conditions.  D. Technological progress inevitably elevates the moral and physical well-being of the working classes.
coreConcept: 核心前提推論：偉大工業財富 vs 人性退化野蠻 -> 繁榮建立在殘酷代價之上 (progress bought at cost of exploitation)。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「The spectacular macroeconomic progress of industrial capitalism was bought at the cost of catastrophic human exploitation.」。前提選項對應 macroeconomic progress bought at the cost of human exploitation。

courseHook.unitTitle: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: A literary critic writes: 'By having Jane Eyre vehemently declare her moral and spiritual equality to Mr. Rochester regardless of social class or gender, Charlotte Brontë did not merely author a compelling romantic dialogue; she fired a shot across the bow of Victorian patriarchal society.' It can be inferred that the critic regards Jane Eyre’s dialogue as:
options: an endorsement of traditional aristocratic gender expectations
a subversive ideological challenge to contemporary socio-cultural hierarchies
a realistic transcription of actual historical conversations recorded in Yorkshire
an unconvincing melodramatic contrivance that detracted from the novel's realism
translation:
【題幹精譯】文學隱喻推論題：評論家指出簡愛宣告自己與羅徹斯特在靈魂與道德上的平等，「絕非僅是一段引人入勝的浪漫愛情對白，而是向維多利亞時代的父權社會猛烈開了一砲」。這說明評論家將其對白視為：對當時社會文化階層架構的顛覆性意識形態挑戰。
【選項列表】A. an endorsement of traditional aristocratic gender expectations  B. a subversive ideological challenge to contemporary socio-cultural hierarchies  C. a realistic transcription of actual historical conversations recorded in Yorkshire  D. an unconvincing melodramatic contrivance that detracted from the novel's realism
coreConcept: 隱喻推論：fired a shot across the bow -> subversive ideological challenge（顛覆性挑戰）。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 激烈地熱烈地慷慨激昂地

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「a subversive ideological challenge to contemporary socio-cultural hierarchies」。推論選項對應 a subversive ideological challenge to hierarchies。

courseHook.unitTitle: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: The political historian writes: 'The Federalist Papers were published under the collective pseudonym *Publius*, effectively obscuring the diverse, and occasionally conflicting, private constitutional interpretations held by Hamilton, Madison, and Jay.' The author’s choice of the word 'obscuring' implies that:
options: the authors intended for their political essays to remain permanently unread by the public
Hamilton, Madison, and Jay held identical philosophical views on the scope of federal executive power
the facade of ideological consensus presented by the authors masked genuine underlying disagreements among them
the American public was unconcerned with the identity of the authors defending the new Constitution
translation:
【題幹精譯】用詞深層暗示推論題：作者指出《聯邦黨人文集》以統一筆名 Publius 發表，有效地「掩蓋隱匿了 (obscuring)」漢密爾頓、麥迪遜與傑伊三人之間多樣且偶有衝突的私人憲法詮釋。使用 obscuring 暗示：文集所呈現的一致共識表象，遮掩了三位起草人之間真實存在的深層分歧。
【選項列表】A. the authors intended for their political essays to remain permanently unread by the public  B. Hamilton, Madison, and Jay held identical philosophical views on the scope of federal executive power  C. the facade of ideological consensus presented by the authors masked genuine underlying disagreements among them  D. the American public was unconcerned with the identity of the authors defending the new Constitution
coreConcept: 用詞潛在暗示：obscuring conflicting interpretations -> masked genuine underlying disagreements（掩飾了深層分歧）。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 正面外表偽裝虛假的外表

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「the facade of ideological consensus presented by the authors masked genuine underlying disagreements among them」。推論選項對應 facade of consensus masked genuine underlying disagreements。

courseHook.unitTitle: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: The historian notes: 'While the architects of the 1919 Treaty of Versailles publicly championed national self-determination, they drew the borders of the newly created mandate states in the Middle East with a ruler and pen, aligning frontiers strictly with British and French petroleum concessions rather than indigenous ethnic distributions.' The author’s choice of language most directly suggests that:
options: the League of Nations succeeded in preventing regional territorial conflicts in the Levant
indigenous Middle Eastern populations drafted the geographical boundaries of the mandate territories
petroleum was a negligible commodity in early twentieth-century international diplomacy
the post-war geopolitical settlement was driven by imperial economic interest rather than principled idealism
translation:
【題幹精譯】歷史推論題：作者指出凡爾賽條約起草人表面上倡導民族自決，但劃定中東邊界時卻是用尺和筆直線切割，嚴格對齊英法石油特許權利益而非當地民族分佈。作者的修辭措辭最直接暗示：戰後的地緣政治劃分是由帝國主義經濟利益驅動，而非崇高的原則理想主義。
【選項列表】A. the League of Nations succeeded in preventing regional territorial conflicts in the Levant  B. indigenous Middle Eastern populations drafted the geographical boundaries of the mandate territories  C. petroleum was a negligible commodity in early twentieth-century international diplomacy  D. the post-war geopolitical settlement was driven by imperial economic interest rather than principled idealism
coreConcept: 深層推論：石油特許權主導劃界 -> 由帝國經濟利益驅動 (driven by imperial economic interest rather than idealism)。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「the post-war geopolitical settlement was driven by imperial economic interest rather than principled idealism」。推論選項對應 geopolitical settlement was driven by imperial economic interest...

courseHook.unitTitle: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: A literary scholar observes: 'Throughout his tragic plays, Shakespeare repeatedly portrays usurping monarchs as being tormented by chronic sleeplessness, from Richard III’s nightmares on the eve of Bosworth to Macbeth’s horrifying realization that he has murdered sleep.' It can be reasonably inferred that the scholar views sleeplessness in Shakespearean tragedy as:
options: a symbolic externalization of moral guilt and psychological unraveling following the subversion of legitimate order
a realistic medical depiction of seventeenth-century neurological and respiratory disorders
a convenient dramaturgical trick to allow actors to change into different theatrical costumes
an indication that Renaissance audiences were unconcerned with ethical questions of royal succession
translation:
【題幹精譯】文學象徵推論題：學者指出莎士比亞在悲劇中屢次將篡位君王描繪為飽受慢性失眠折磨（從理查三世的噩夢到馬克白驚呼自己謀殺了睡眠）。由此可合理推知：學者將莎劇中的失眠解讀為顛覆合法統治秩序後，道德罪疚感與心理崩潰瓦解的象徵性外化表徵。
【選項列表】A. a symbolic externalization of moral guilt and psychological unraveling following the subversion of legitimate order  B. a realistic medical depiction of seventeenth-century neurological and respiratory disorders  C. a convenient dramaturgical trick to allow actors to change into different theatrical costumes  D. an indication that Renaissance audiences were unconcerned with ethical questions of royal succession
coreConcept: 象徵意義推論：篡位失眠 -> 道德罪疚與心理崩潰的外在象徵 (symbolic externalization of moral guilt)。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「a symbolic externalization of moral guilt and psychological unraveling following the subversion of legitimate order」。推論選項對應 a symbolic externalization of moral guilt and psychological unraveling...

courseHook.unitTitle: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: An economic historian writes: 'The British East India Company’s transformation from a mercantile commercial enterprise into a sovereign territorial ruler was cemented when the Mughal Emperor granted it the *Diwani* in 1765—the legal right to collect land revenue across Bengal—effectively turning a joint-stock company into a tax collector armed with private standing armies.' The passage implies that the acquisition of the *Diwani* represented:
options: the complete bankruptcy and subsequent financial liquidation of the East India Company
a structural blurring of commercial enterprise and colonial state power
a peaceful diplomatic victory that dismantled military fortifications across the Indian subcontinent
an economic policy that transferred all tax revenues directly into public welfare for Bengali villagers
translation:
【題幹精譯】經濟史深層暗示推論題：東印度公司自純商業公司轉變為領土統治者，關鍵在於 1765 年取得莫臥兒帝國授予在孟加拉徵稅的權利，使其成為擁有私家軍隊的包稅人。這段話暗示取得徵稅特權代表了：商業企業法人與殖民國家公權力之間的結構性模糊與融合。
【選項列表】A. the complete bankruptcy and subsequent financial liquidation of the East India Company  B. a structural blurring of commercial enterprise and colonial state power  C. a peaceful diplomatic victory that dismantled military fortifications across the Indian subcontinent  D. an economic policy that transferred all tax revenues directly into public welfare for Bengali villagers
coreConcept: 結構推論：公司徵稅配私軍 -> 商業與國家權力的模糊融合 (structural blurring of commercial and state power)。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 商業的重商主義的貿易的
主權的主權獨立的統治者

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「a structural blurring of commercial enterprise and colonial state power」。推論選項對應 a structural blurring of commercial enterprise and colonial state power。

courseHook.unitTitle: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: The anthropologist writes: 'Among the Kwakwaka'wakw peoples of the Pacific Northwest, the competitive potlatch ceremony functioned not to accumulate material wealth, but to ostentatiously destroy or distribute it, establishing aristocratic prestige through the spectacle of boundless generosity.' What underlying assumption governs the potlatch tradition described?
options: Wealth accumulation is the universal prerequisite for entering the tribal warrior class.
Indigenous Pacific Northwest communities lacked any concept of hereditary hierarchy or aristocratic status.
Social status and political legitimacy are mediated through the conspicuous distribution rather than hoarding of resources.
The potlatch was outlawed by elders because it threatened to exhaust the salmon fisheries.
translation:
【題幹精譯】人類學前提推論題：夸夸嘉夸族誇富宴 (potlatch) 的功能並非累積物質財富，而是高調銷毀或分發物資，以無限慷慨的盛況確立貴族威望。這項傳統背後的隱含核心假定是：社會地位與政治合法性，係透過大張旗鼓的資源散播分發、而非囤積居奇來衡量與體現。
【選項列表】A. Wealth accumulation is the universal prerequisite for entering the tribal warrior class.  B. Indigenous Pacific Northwest communities lacked any concept of hereditary hierarchy or aristocratic status.  C. Social status and political legitimacy are mediated through the conspicuous distribution rather than hoarding of resources.  D. The potlatch was outlawed by elders because it threatened to exhaust the salmon fisheries.
coreConcept: 人類學核心前提：聲望取決於分發散播而非囤積 (mediated through conspicuous distribution rather than hoarding)。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 誇富宴北美原住民贈禮儀式
鋪張地炫耀地大張旗鼓地

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「Social status and political legitimacy are mediated through the conspicuous distribution rather than hoarding of resources.」。前提選項對應 Social status is mediated through distribution rather than hoarding of resources。

tierLabel: Level 6: Digital SAT 學術思維 (SAT B2~C1)
subtopic: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions
prompt: The art historian writes: 'By placing the mirrors directly opposite the windows in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles, Jules Hardouin-Mansart did not merely maximize natural daylight; he created an optical metaphor wherein the Sun King's radiant majesty was infinitely multiplied across the French realm.' The author's observation assumes that:
options: seventeenth-century glass manufacturing was too technologically primitive to produce clear mirror glass
Louis XIV was indifferent to visual symbolism and personal monarchical aggrandizement
the Hall of Mirrors was constructed primarily to provide entertainment for foreign tourist delegations
architectural spatial design can be deliberately employed as an ideological instrument of royal propaganda
translation:
【題幹精譯】建築藝術史假設推論題：凡爾賽宮鏡廳將鏡子正對窗戶，不僅採光，更創造了一種象徵太陽王光芒萬丈在法蘭西國土無限反射倍增的光學隱喻。該觀察背後的隱含前提是：建築空間設計能夠被有意識地作為王室政治宣傳與意識形態統治的有力工具。
【選項列表】A. seventeenth-century glass manufacturing was too technologically primitive to produce clear mirror glass  B. Louis XIV was indifferent to visual symbolism and personal monarchical aggrandizement  C. the Hall of Mirrors was constructed primarily to provide entertainment for foreign tourist delegations  D. architectural spatial design can be deliberately employed as an ideological instrument of royal propaganda
coreConcept: 隱含前提推論：鏡廳光學隱喻神化君權 -> 建築被用作宣傳工具 (architectural design employed as instrument of propaganda)。
sentenceAnalysis: SAT 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 光芒四射的容光煥發的
擴大地位提升權勢增大

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「architectural spatial design can be deliberately employed as an ideological instrument of royal propaganda」。前提選項對應 architectural spatial design can be employed as an instrument of propaganda。

courseHook.unitTitle: Pragmatic Inference & Implicit Assumptions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: The diplomat’s outward veneer of affability ___ an unyielding, ruthless determination to impose harsh economic sanctions on his adversaries.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位外交官外表展現出親和友善的和藹面具，「掩蓋掩飾了」他對敵手實施嚴酷經濟制裁時那種毫不退讓、冷酷無情的冷酷決心。
【選項列表】A. belied  B. corroborated  C. presaged  D. amplified
coreConcept: belie 意為「掩飾、使…產生錯覺、與…不符」，完美體現 outward veneer（表面偽裝）與 ruthless determination（冷酷內在）之間的強烈反差對比。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 掩飾證明為虛假與…不符

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「belied」。GRE 核心轉折動詞：belie（掩蓋、證明…為虛假）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: Far from being the ___ novice depicted in tabloid profiles, the young chess prodigy executed opening maneuvers with veteran calculating cunning.
translation:
【題幹精譯】絕非小報花邊新聞所描繪的那般「天真單純無邪」，這位年輕的國際象棋神童以老牌大師般的精算老練狡黠，凌厲展開了開局佈局。
【選項列表】A. sagacious  B. ingenuous  C. mercenary  D. pugnacious
coreConcept: Far from being... 提示反轉：後方為 veteran cunning（老練狡黠），前方空格必為反義詞 ingenuous（天真純樸的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 天真的單純純樸的坦白的
睿智的精明的有遠見的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「ingenuous」。反義詞對立：veteran cunning 對應 ingenuous（純真無邪的）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: Although the literary critic’s review appeared outwardly complimentary, a careful reader could detect an undercurrent of ___ irony directed at the author’s pretension.
translation:
【題幹精譯】儘管該文學評論家的書評表面看似充滿溢美之辭，但細心的讀者卻能察覺其中暗藏著一股針對作者浮誇做作的「尖刻辛辣的」反諷潛流。
【選項列表】A. laudatory  B. sycophantic  C. caustic  D. deferential
coreConcept: Although appeared complimentary 轉折對立，空格需填負面尖酸詞 caustic（尖刻的、腐蝕性的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「caustic」。讓步轉折反差：complimentary 對應 caustic irony。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: Rather than surrendering to the pervasive cynicism of his contemporaries, the philosopher maintained an ___ faith in humanity’s moral progress.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位哲學家並未屈服於同時代人普遍瀰漫的犬儒虛無主義，反而始終堅持著對人類道德進步「永不衰竭/堅定不移的」崇高信念。
【選項列表】A. ephemeral  B. equivocal  C. indolent  D. unflagging
coreConcept: Rather than surrendering to cynicism 反轉對立，哲學家維持著 unflagging（不懈的、不衰退的）信念。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 犬儒主義憤世嫉俗玩世不恭
永不減弱的不懈的精力充沛的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「unflagging」。轉折反向選詞：unflagging faith（堅定不移的信念）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: Despite his reputation for extreme parsimony in personal expenditures, the retired tycoon was remarkably ___ when endowing university research scholarships.
translation:
【題幹精譯】儘管該退休大亨在個人日常生活開銷方面以極度吝嗇小氣聞名，但在資助成立大學科研獎學金時，卻顯得異常「慷慨解囊/揮金如土」。
【選項列表】A. munificent  B. penurious  C. frugal  D. churlish
coreConcept: Despite parsimony（吝嗇小氣）讓步轉折，後方必填表示無私慷慨的褒義詞 munificent（極慷慨的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「munificent」。強烈反義對比：parsimony 對應 munificent（極其慷慨的）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: While the spokesperson insisted that the border troop mobilization was purely defensive, international observers interpreted the maneuvers as an ___ prelude to an invasion.
translation:
【題幹精譯】儘管官方發言人堅稱邊境軍隊集結純屬防禦性質，但國際軍事觀察家卻將該演習舉動解讀為一場入侵即將爆發的「昭然若揭/無可置疑的」前奏序曲。
【選項列表】A. ambiguous  B. unmistakable  C. anodyne  D. inadvertent
coreConcept: While insisted defensive 對比轉折，觀察家解讀為毫不掩飾的侵略信號，選 unmistakable（昭然若揭的、清晰無誤的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 止痛劑平淡無奇的溫和的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「unmistakable」。轉折對立選 unmistakable（昭然若揭的）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: The archival discovery did not refute the orthodox historical consensus; ___, it supplied corroborating documentary evidence that solidified the thesis.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這項檔案歷史文獻的新發現非但沒有推翻正統的史學共識；「恰恰相反」，它提供了進一步佐證的文獻證據，使原論點更加牢不可破。
【選項列表】A. inconsequentially  B. superficially  C. on the contrary  D. sporadically
coreConcept: did not refute... on the contrary supplied corroborating... 否定後強力反向遞進轉折，選 on the contrary。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「on the contrary」。否定逆轉銜接詞選 on the contrary。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: The monarch’s seemingly benevolent concessions were not motivated by altruism, but were rather ___ ploys intended to fracture the united coalition of dissenting nobles.
translation:
【題幹精譯】君王表面上看似仁慈的政治讓步絕非出於無私利他主義，反而是意在分化瓦解反對派貴族同盟的「馬基維利式權謀詭詐的」陰險手段。
【選項列表】A. seraphic  B. quixotic  C. magnanimous  D. Machiavellian
coreConcept: not altruism but rather... 對立轉折，排除利他，指向權術心計 Machiavellian（不擇手段權謀的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 馬基維利式的狡猾權謀的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「Machiavellian」。語意對立：not altruism but Machiavellian ploys。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: Far from presenting a unified front, the parliamentary caucus was notoriously ___, fractured by bitter ideological schisms and personal feuds.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該議會黨團非但沒有展現團結一致的陣容，反而以「狂躁易怒/派系紛爭不斷的」惡名昭彰，被深層的意識形態分裂與私人恩怨撕裂得四分五裂。
【選項列表】A. fractious  B. monolithic  C. harmonious  D. placid
coreConcept: Far from unified front 提示反義，fractured by schisms 提示填 fractious（易怒爭吵不合的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 易怒暴躁的搞分裂的難對付的
鐵板一塊的龐大單一的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「fractious」。反義詞選定：unified 對應 fractious（搞分裂的、難駕馭的）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal
prompt: Despite the company’s glowing quarterly earnings report, savvy equity analysts suspected that the stellar margins were largely ___ and concealed looming insolvency.
translation:
【題幹精譯】儘管該公司公布了令人炫目的季度盈餘財報，但精明的證券分析師卻懷疑其亮眼利潤率多半是「虛幻泡影的」，掩蓋了迫在眉睫的破產危機。
【選項列表】A. verifiable  B. illusory  C. sustainable  D. tangible
coreConcept: Despite glowing report... concealed looming insolvency，利潤率實為虛假，選 illusory（虛幻的、虛假的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 虛幻的幻覺的不切實際的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「illusory」。表象與本質轉折對比：glowing vs illusory。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Contrast & Reversal 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: The sudden collapse of the regional agricultural harvest was ___ by an unprecedented combination of multi-year drought and insect infestation.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該地區農作物收成的突然全面崩潰瓦解，是由多年持續乾旱與毀滅性蟲害史無前例的雙重夾擊所「催生引發的」。
【選項列表】A. precluded  B. mitigated  C. engendered  D. repudiated
coreConcept: engender 意為「產生、引起、催生」，精準表述災害因素促成崩潰之因果必然性。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「engendered」。GRE 核心因果動詞：engender（引起、產生、催生）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: Because the archival record was notoriously fragmentary, the biographer had to exercise immense imaginative empathy to ___ the obscure motivations of the hermit poet.
translation:
【題幹精譯】由於歷史檔案文獻極其殘缺零碎，傳記作家不得不發揮深厚的想像同理心，以「描摹勾勒出」這位隱士詩人晦澀隱密的心理動機。
【選項列表】A. obfuscate  B. dissemble  C. abrogate  D. delineate
coreConcept: delineate 意為「生動描繪、精準刻劃勾勒」，呼應作家重塑詩人動機的學術努力。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「delineate」。因果目的動詞選 delineate（精確描摹）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: The discovery of deep-sea hydrothermal vents ___ long-standing geochemical dogma and catalyzed a total paradigm shift across marine biology.
translation:
【題幹精譯】深海地熱噴口的驚人發現，徹底「顛覆瓦解了」長久以來的地球化學傳統教條，並在整個海洋生物學領域催生引發了一場徹底的典範轉移。
【選項列表】A. subverted  B. buttressed  C. vindicated  D. enshrined
coreConcept: subvert（顛覆）呼應後方 catalyzed a total paradigm shift（催生典範轉移），強化對舊教條的打擊。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「subverted」。強化因果動詞選 subverted（顛覆傳統教條）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: The governor's reckless deregulation of the municipal water authority effectively ___ the catastrophic lead contamination crisis.
translation:
【題幹精譯】州長對市屬供水管理局魯莽輕率的撤銷監管鬆綁政策，直接「導致促成引發了」災難性的重金屬鉛水污染公衛危機。
【選項列表】A. obviated  B. precipitated  C. ameliorated  D. stifled
coreConcept: precipitate 意為「促成、加速引發（災難等）」，為因果邏輯核心動詞。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 加速促成沉澱猛然降下

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「precipitated」。因果加速促成動詞選 precipitated（加速促發危機）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: By meticulously documenting systemic bribery across municipal ministries, the investigative journalist’s exposé ___ widespread public outrage.
translation:
【題幹精譯】藉由巨細靡遺地詳實記錄市政各部會系統性行賄受賄醜聞，這名調查記者的揭弊深度報導一舉「激發喚醒了」社會大眾普遍的憤怒浪潮。
【選項列表】A. quelled  B. pacified  C. galvanized  D. attenuated
coreConcept: galvanize 意為「激勵、激起、使受電擊般震動驚醒」，接 public outrage 為經典同義強化搭配。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 揭弊報導揭發真相的陳述

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「galvanized」。激發公眾情緒動詞選 galvanized。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: The newly unearthed epigraphic inscriptions perfectly ___ the controversial thesis that the Bronze Age trading network extended into the Baltic.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這批新出土的古代銘刻碑文，完美地「證實佐證了」青銅時代海上貿易網絡曾一路延伸至波羅的海這項曾飽受爭議的假說。
【選項列表】A. gainsaid  B. debunked  C. impugned  D. corroborated
coreConcept: corroborate 意為「證實、提供支持證據」，加強論點正向真實性。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「corroborated」。強化證實動詞選 corroborated。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: Because the pharmaceutical compound exhibited extreme instability at room temperature, chemical engineers formulated an ___ polymer coating to protect its potency.
translation:
【題幹精譯】由於該醫藥化合物在室溫條件下表現出極端不穩定性，化學工程師精心調配了一種「不可滲透的/密封絕緣的」聚合物保護塗層以捍衛其藥效活性。
【選項列表】A. impervious  B. porous  C. ephemeral  D. osmotic
coreConcept: Because exhibited instability... 採取保護措施，塗層需具備隔離防滲透性，選 impervious。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 不能滲透的不受影響的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「impervious」。因果保護對應選 impervious（防滲透的）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: The sheer ubiquity of algorithmic surveillance in modern urban spaces has ___ a profound erosion of civil privacy expectations.
translation:
【題幹精譯】現代城市空間中演算法無孔不入的普遍監控監聽，直接「助長促成了」公民對隱私保護預期心理的深層侵蝕淪喪。
【選項列表】A. thwarted  B. fostered  C. forestalled  D. preempted
coreConcept: foster 意為「促進、助長、培養」，在此作為因果連結動詞。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「fostered」。因果助長動詞選 fostered。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: The decisive victory of the unionized workforce in the national strike ___ similar labor mobilization campaigns across industrial sectors.
translation:
【題幹精譯】工會勞工在全國大罷工中所取得的決定性重大勝利，「激發引發帶動了」其他各工業部門展開類似的勞工動員抗爭運動。
【選項列表】A. deterred  B. paralyzed  C. instigated  D. suppressed
coreConcept: instigate 意為「發起、促成、煽動引發」，強化首創勝利對後續抗爭的推動作用。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「instigated」。因果帶動發起動詞選 instigated。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement
prompt: The sudden influx of cheap overseas textiles inevitably ___ domestic artisanal weavers, driving centuries-old handicraft guilds into bankruptcy.
translation:
【題幹精譯】廉價海外紡織品的突發大量湧入，無可避免地「重創摧毀了」本土傳統手工織布業者，迫使擁有數百年傳承的手工藝行會走向破產破亡。
【選項列表】A. bolstered  B. subsidized  C. rehabilitated  D. devastated
coreConcept: driving guilds into bankruptcy 提示前句結果之慘烈，選 devastated（毀滅、摧毀）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「devastated」。因果惡性後果動詞選 devastated。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Cause, Effect & Reinforcement 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: The treatise was undeniably erudite; ___, its author’s refusal to engage with contemporary feminist scholarship rendered its conclusions strikingly dated.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該專著無可否認地博大精深且博雅宏富；「然而/儘管如此」，其作者斷然拒絕與當代女性主義學術進行對話，使其結論顯得驚人地陳舊過時。
【選項列表】A. yet  B. moreover  C. consequently  D. similarly
coreConcept: 前句誇獎極其博學 (undeniably erudite)，後句指出致命盲點 (dated conclusions)，極致讓步轉折選 yet。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「yet」。學術讓步資格限定選 yet。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: The physicist’s formulation, while mathematically ___, was predicated on an unverified physical assumption regarding extra spatial dimensions.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該物理學家的公式推導在數學邏輯層面上雖然「無懈可擊/完美無瑕」，但其基礎卻建立在一個有關額外空間維度的未經驗證物理假定之上。
【選項列表】A. shoddy  B. impeccable  C. pedestrian  D. meretricious
coreConcept: while 引導讓步：後方轉折指出前提未經驗證，空格必為對數學純熟度的最高讚譽褒義詞 impeccable（無懈可擊的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 華而不實的金玉其外的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「impeccable」。讓步褒貶對立：while mathematically impeccable, predicated on unverified assumption...

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: It is a profound historical paradox that the monarch’s most ___ policies—intended to suppress dissent—actually accelerated the republican revolution.
translation:
【題幹精譯】歷史上一個深刻的諷刺悖論在於，這位君王所推行之最為「高壓專制鎮壓的」政治政策——原本意在壓制異議——實際上卻反而加速了共和革命的徹底爆發。
【選項列表】A. conciliatory  B. lax  C. repressive  D. magnanimous
coreConcept: intended to suppress dissent 呼應 repressive（鎮壓殘暴的），與加速革命構成歷史悖論。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「repressive」。悖論特徵詞選 repressive（高壓鎮壓的）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: While the novelist’s prose is undeniably dense and at times opaque, persistent readers will find its intellectual rewards far from ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】儘管該小說家的散文文筆無可否認地晦澀繁密且時而令人費解，但堅持讀下去的讀者將會發現其精神思想回報「絕非無足輕重/絕非微不足道」。
【選項列表】A. monumental  B. profound  C. formidable  D. inconsequential
coreConcept: far from inconsequential (雙重否定表強烈肯定)，呼應前面的 intellectual rewards。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 無關緊要的微不足道的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「inconsequential」。雙重否定修辭：far from inconsequential（意義重大深遠）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: The politician’s speech was marked by an artful ___, allowing divergent factions to project their own conflicting agendas onto his ambiguous words.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位政客的演說以巧妙的「模稜兩可含糊其辭」為特徵，使得不同對立派系得以將各自衝突的政治訴求投射到其模稜兩可的措辭之中。
【選項列表】A. equivocation  B. candor  C. forthrightness  D. pedantry
coreConcept: allowing divergent factions... ambiguous words 提示特質必為說話含糊不表態的 equivocation（模稜兩可）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 含糊其辭模稜兩可躲閃推諉

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「equivocation」。語意特徵匹配：ambiguous words 呼應 equivocation。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: Although the museum retrospective was promoted as comprehensive, scholars noted that the artist's controversial political murals were ___ excluded.
translation:
【題幹精譯】儘管該美術館回顧展被宣傳為全面性的完整展覽，但學者敏銳注意到，該藝術家最具爭議性的政治壁畫作品卻被「顯眼醒目地/令人矚目地」刻意排除在外。
【選項列表】A. inadvertently  B. conspicuously  C. negligibly  D. imperceptibly
coreConcept: promoted as comprehensive vs excluded 構成諷刺對立，且是顯而易見的刻意排除，選 conspicuously（引人注目地）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「conspicuously」。諷刺限定副詞選 conspicuously excluded。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: The revolutionary manifesto combined fiery radical rhetoric with surprisingly ___ fiscal and administrative proposals.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這份革命宣言將慷慨激昂的激進激進修辭口號，與令人驚訝的「極其保守正統的」財政與行政管理提案巧妙混雜在一起。
【選項列表】A. anarchic  B. subversive  C. orthodox  D. iconoclastic
coreConcept: combined fiery radical rhetoric with surprisingly... 構成激進與保守之強烈悖論反差，選 orthodox（正統保守的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「orthodox」。悖論反差選詞：radical 搭配 orthodox。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: The archaeological artifact was an ___: a bronze timepiece recovered from a stratum firmly dated to three centuries before clockwork was invented.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這件出土考古文物簡直是一項「時代錯置物/年代矛盾奇物」：這是一隻在被牢固斷代為發條鐘錶發明前三百年之古老地層中所挖掘出的青銅計時器械。
【選項列表】A. epiphany  B. apotheosis  C. exemplar  D. anachronism
coreConcept: recovered from strata 3 centuries before invented 完美符合 anachronism（時代錯置、年代不合時宜之物）的定義。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 時代錯置不合時代之事物

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「anachronism」。年代錯置核心詞：anachronism。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: Though the theory possesses undeniable intuitive appeal, rigorous empirical testing has revealed it to be largely ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】儘管該理論在直覺認知上具備不可否認的吸引力，但嚴謹的實證科學檢驗卻揭示出它在很大程度上「似是而非/華而不實虛假的」。
【選項列表】A. specious  B. irrefutable  C. axiomatic  D. incontestable
coreConcept: intuitive appeal vs empirical testing has revealed... 揭露真相為假象，選 specious（似是而非的、外表合理實則虛假的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 似是而非的徒有其表的華而不實的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「specious」。表象與實質反差：specious（似是而非的）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox
prompt: The memoirist paints a portrait of her grandfather that is far from hagiographic; on the contrary, she chronicles his foibles with ___ candor.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位回憶錄作者為其祖父所刻畫的形象絕非聖徒傳記式的歌功頌德；恰恰相反，她以「毫不留情不加掩飾的」坦率真誠，詳加記錄了他生前的種種怪癖與人性弱點。
【選項列表】A. deferential  B. unsparing  C. sanctimonious  D. sycophantic
coreConcept: far from hagiographic (聖徒傳般的諂媚) -> chronicles his foibles with unsparing candor (毫不留情的坦誠)。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 聖徒傳的過度崇拜美化的
毫不留情的嚴酷的無情的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「unsparing」。反義強化搭配：unsparing candor（毫不避諱的直率）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Semantic Clues: Qualification & Paradox 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: The defense attorney’s closing argument degenerated into a venomous ___ against the integrity of the prosecution witnesses.
translation:
【題幹精譯】辯護律師的結案辯詞墮落演變成了一場針對檢方證人個人品格操守的惡毒「漫罵誹謗/嚴厲抨擊」。
【選項列表】A. panegyric  B. encomium  C. diatribe  D. accolade
coreConcept: venomous（惡毒的）修飾負面名詞 diatribe（抨擊、痛罵長篇大論）；其他三項皆為歌頌讚美褒義詞。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 謾罵痛斥抨擊長篇大論

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「diatribe」。極端負向極性詞選 diatribe（痛罵誹謗）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: Far from offering an objective historiography, the court scribe produced a shameless ___ that elevated the despotic emperor to a demigod.
translation:
【題幹精譯】朝廷史官非但沒有提供客觀公正的史學編撰，反而炮製出了一篇將殘暴專制皇帝神化為半神的不知羞恥的「阿諛奉承頌文/讚歌」。
【選項列表】A. jeremiad  B. invective  C. indictment  D. panegyric
coreConcept: elevated the despotic emperor to a demigod 提示極端崇拜讚美，選 panegyric（頌歌、讚辭）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「panegyric」。極端讚揚極性詞選 panegyric。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: Critics roundly condemned the documentary for its ___ portrayal of historical events, arguing that it deliberately omitted counter-evidence to advance an ideological agenda.
translation:
【題幹精譯】各界影評人對該紀錄片針對歷史事件所採取的「帶偏向性/有蓄意傾向的」片面描繪發出了齊聲嚴厲譴責，指責其蓄意隱匿反面證據以推動特定意識形態訴求。
【選項列表】A. tendentious  B. dispassionate  C. equitable  D. unbiased
coreConcept: deliberately omitted counter-evidence 說明其帶有極端偏見與傾向性，選 tendentious（有偏向的、有特定宣傳目的的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 有偏見的有傾向性的蓄意偏袒的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「tendentious」。學術負向極性詞選 tendentious。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: The newly appointed director delivered an ___ address praising the frontline healthcare workers for their selfless heroism during the pandemic.
translation:
【題幹精譯】新任總監發表了一篇熱情洋溢的「崇高頌文/盛讚之詞」，盛讚第一線醫療人員在疫情肆虐期間所展現出的無私英雄主義氣概。
【選項列表】A. diatribe  B. encomium  C. animadversion  D. stricture
coreConcept: praising... for selfless heroism 提示填高度讚美的名詞 encomium（讚頌、頌詞）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「encomium」。正向高度讚美詞選 encomium。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: The investigative report offered a blistering ___ of the regulatory agency's systemic cronyism and failure to enforce environmental laws.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這份調查深度報告，針對監管機構內部的系統性裙帶官僚風氣以及其執法不力之失職，提出了一份措辭極其嚴厲的「控訴譴責/定罪控書」。
【選項列表】A. eulogy  B. homage  C. indictment  D. sanction
coreConcept: blistering（尖銳猛烈的）搭配負向譴責名詞 indictment（控訴、譴責）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 控訴起訴指控嚴厲批評

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「indictment」。嚴厲譴責名詞選 indictment。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: The senator dismissed the opposition's claims as mere partisan ___, devoid of substantive factual corroboration.
translation:
【題幹精譯】參議員對反對派的指控斥之以鼻，斥責其純屬政黨惡鬥的「惡毒漫罵攻擊」，完全缺乏任何實質的事實依據佐證。
【選項列表】A. plaudits  B. tribute  C. approbation  D. invective
coreConcept: mere partisan... devoid of fact 提示強烈負面辱罵之詞，選 invective（漫罵、惡言痛斥）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「invective」。政治負向漫罵詞選 invective。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: The retiring professor was deeply moved by the outpouring of ___ delivered by her former doctoral students at the commemorative gala.
translation:
【題幹精譯】在榮退紀念晚宴上，這位退休老教授被其昔日指導之博士生們所齊聲獻上的真摯「崇高讚譽與褒獎」深深感動。
【選項列表】A. accolades  B. calumnies  C. reproaches  D. denouncements
coreConcept: commemorative gala honoring a professor 應為正向讚頌，選 accolades（讚賞、榮譽讚譽）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「accolades」。正向榮譽褒揚詞選 accolades。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: The author’s latest novel is a ___ lament for the lost innocence of rural agricultural life in the shadow of relentless industrialization.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位作家最新出版的小說，是一曲在無情工業化巨浪陰影下，為鄉村農業社會已逝去之純真質樸所譜寫的「令人心酸悽楚的/深刻感人的」悲愴哀歌。
【選項列表】A. facetious  B. poignant  C. flippant  D. callous
coreConcept: lament for lost innocence 提示深沉哀傷感人，選 poignant（深刻心酸的、觸動人心的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 令人心酸的深刻感人的痛苦的
開玩笑的滑稽不合時宜的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「poignant」。文學情感極性選 poignant（淒美感人的）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: The anonymous pamphlet was a cowardly piece of ___, filled with fabricated scandals aimed at destroying the minister's public standing.
translation:
【題幹精譯】那份匿名黑函小冊子是一篇卑鄙懦弱的「惡意中傷誣衊/誹謗文章」，充斥著旨在摧毀該部長公眾政治聲望的蓄意捏造醜聞。
【選項列表】A. eulogy  B. panegyric  C. calumny  D. commendation
coreConcept: cowardly, filled with fabricated scandals 提示填惡毒誣陷名詞 calumny（誹謗、中傷）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「calumny」。誹謗中傷專用詞選 calumny。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions
prompt: The young violinist received universal ___ from the notoriously demanding music critics of Vienna following her virtuoso performance.
translation:
【題幹精譯】在這場堪稱宗師級的大師演奏會之後，這位年輕的小提琴家贏得了維也納出了名挑剔苛刻之音樂評論家們一致的「由衷讚許/認可褒揚」。
【選項列表】A. animadversion  B. censure  C. disapprobation  D. approbation
coreConcept: universal... following virtuoso performance 提示極致讚揚，選 approbation（認可、讚許）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「approbation」。正向讚賞詞選 approbation。

courseHook.unitTitle: Intricate Polarity: Scholarly Attributions 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: The new evidence presented by the defense attorney was so ___ that even the most skeptical jurors were persuaded of the defendant’s innocence.
translation:
【題幹精譯】辯護律師所提出的新物證是如此「具有壓倒性說服力的」，以致於連法庭上最生性多疑的陪審員也被徹底說服確信被告無罪。
【選項列表】A. compelling  B. conjectural  C. dubious  D. specious
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：由 jurors were persuaded（陪審員被說服）強烈提示該證據具備無可置疑的證明力，唯一正解為 compelling（令人信服的）。其餘選項中，conjectural（推測性的）、dubious（可疑的）、specious（似是而非的）皆表不確定或負向，與文意相悖。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 令人信服的引人注目的強制的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「compelling」。單選精準考點：鎖定具有壓倒性說服力之形容詞 compelling。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: Rather than embracing a single school of thought, the philosopher adopted an ___ approach, synthesizing tenets from divergent traditions.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該哲學家並未獨尊某一特定學派，而是採取了一種「兼收並蓄多元折衷的」綜合方法，將不同流派的核心信條融會貫通。
【選項列表】A. parochial  B. eclectic  C. insular  D. dogmatic
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：由 Rather than embracing a single school（而非獨尊單一派別）與 synthesizing tenets from divergent traditions（整合不同傳統）可知，此方法具備博採眾長之特點，唯一正解為 eclectic（折衷的、兼容並蓄的）。parochial（狹隘的）、insular（偏狹的）、dogmatic（教條頑固的）皆表示排他與封閉，與句意完全相反。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 折衷的相容並蓄的多元的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「eclectic」。單選精準考點：博採各家之長選用 eclectic。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: The minister's private diary revealed a temperament marked by sudden ___ swings, alternating unpredictably between ecstatic exuberance and profound melancholia.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該部長的私人日記揭示了一種以劇烈突發的「善變多變/捉摸不定」為特徵的性格，毫無規律地在狂喜激昂與深沉憂鬱之間反覆橫跳。
【選項列表】A. stolid  B. equable  C. mercurial  D. phlegmatic
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：線索在於 alternating unpredictably between ecstatic exuberance and profound melancholia（在極度狂喜與深淵抑鬱間無規律擺盪），唯有 mercurial（善變的、反覆無常的）精準表達此情緒極端跳躍。其餘干擾選項 stolid（麻木遲鈍的）、equable（溫和穩定的）、phlegmatic（冷靜淡漠的）皆強調心境不起波瀾，與文意完全相悖。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 善變的反覆無常的水銀的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「mercurial」。單選精準考點：情緒劇烈擺盪善變選 mercurial。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: Far from presenting a revolutionary breakthrough, the research paper merely offered a ___ rehash of established sociological models.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該研究論文非但沒有提出任何革命性的突破創新，反而只不過是對已確立之社會學模型進行了一場「平庸乏味毫無新意的」炒冷飯。
【選項列表】A. esoteric  B. groundbreaking  C. provocative  D. pedestrian
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：句首 Far from presenting a revolutionary breakthrough（遠非革命性突破）與 mere rehash（純屬炒冷飯）決定空格必須填入表達平庸、老套、缺乏創見的負向形容詞，唯一正選為 pedestrian（平庸乏味的、毫無想像力的）。groundbreaking（開創性的）與 provocative（啟發性的）與文意相反；esoteric（深奧難懂的）偏離平庸主旨。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 平庸乏味的毫無想像力的徒步的
深奧的難解的圈內人懂的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「pedestrian」。單選精準考點：缺乏新意炒冷飯選 pedestrian。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: The newly unearthed legal codex is of ___ importance to epigraphers, as it represents the earliest extant documentation of Babylonian contract law.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這部新出土的古代法律抄本對銘文專家而言具有「至高無上/最為重大」的非凡意義，因為它是巴比倫契約法現存最早的第一本文獻紀錄。
【選項列表】A. paramount  B. inconsequential  C. peripheral  D. trifling
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：由 earliest extant documentation（現存最早紀錄）可知該典籍在學術史上具有極致的核心地位，唯一正確為 paramount（至高無上的、首要的）。其餘干擾項 inconsequential（無關緊要的）、peripheral（邊緣次要的）、trifling（微不足道的）皆與文意強烈衝突。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 至高無上的最重要的首要的
無足輕重的微不足道的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「paramount」。單選精準考點：至關重大首要地位選 paramount。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: The literary biographer’s portrayal of the poet was criticized for being excessively ___, glossing over his notorious interpersonal cruelty in order to preserve his heroic mythos.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位文學傳記作家對該詩人的刻畫描寫遭到了廣泛嚴厲抨擊，被指責為「過度美化吹捧/聖徒傳式的神化」，刻意粉飾了他生前惡名昭彰的人際殘酷行徑以維護其英雄神話。
【選項列表】A. trenchant  B. hagiographic  C. scathing  D. derisive
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：關鍵線索為 glossing over his cruelty in order to preserve his heroic mythos（粉飾殘酷以維繫英雄神話），說明該傳記並非客觀記述，而是進行盲目崇拜的美化神化，唯一正解為 hagiographic（聖徒傳式的、過分諂媚神化的）。trenchant（犀利深刻的）、scathing（嚴厲抨擊的）、derisive（嘲弄譏諷的）皆為批判性詞彙，與過度美化神化完全相反。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 聖徒傳記的美化的神化吹捧的
尖銳的犀利的深刻有力的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「hagiographic」。單選精準考點：粉飾缺點過分美化選 hagiographic。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: The diplomat’s statement was intentionally ___, calculated to reassure domestic constituents while committing the administration to no specific military action.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該外交官發表的聲明經過精心推敲，故意顯得「模稜兩可/含糊其辭」，旨在安撫國內選民的同時，不讓政府承擔任何具體軍事行動的實質義務。
【選項列表】A. lucid  B. unambiguous  C. ambiguous  D. categorical
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：語境表明外交官一方面要安撫民眾，另一方面卻不願意被任何具體軍事承諾綁死（committing to no specific action），故其言辭必然具備刻意製造的彈性與模糊空間，唯一正選為 ambiguous（含糊不清的、模稜兩可的）。干擾選項 lucid（明晰清晰的）、unambiguous（毫不含糊的）、categorical（斷然明確的）皆為反義詞。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 模稜兩可的含糊不清的曖昧的
清晰透明的清澈的頭腦清醒的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「ambiguous」。單選精準考點：故意不作承諾之含糊措辭選 ambiguous。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: Despite the arid conditions of the desert plateau, certain succulent plant species manage to ___ in rocky fissures where condensation collects.
translation:
【題幹精譯】儘管沙漠高原氣候條件極端乾旱貧瘠，某些多肉植物依然能夠在聚集凝結水氣的岩石縫隙之中「繁茂茁壯生長」。
【選項列表】A. languish  B. wither  C. perish  D. thrive
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：句首 Despite the arid conditions（儘管條件嚴酷）引導讓步轉折，表示植物不但沒有枯死，反而克服惡劣逆境成功繁衍生長，唯一正解為 thrive（茁壯生長、繁榮興旺）。反向干擾項 languish（凋零衰弱）、wither（枯萎萎縮）、perish（死亡消亡）均與讓步轉折方向相反。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「thrive」。單選精準考點：逆境中成功茁壯繁榮選 thrive。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: The CEO’s decision to liquidate the unprofitable foreign subsidiary was widely praised as a ___ move that safeguarded the firm’s core balance sheet.
translation:
【題幹精譯】執行長將長期虧損的外國子公司進行清算裁撤的決斷，被各界普遍讚譽為一記「審慎明智的」高明之舉，成功捍衛了集團的核心資產負債表健全。
【選項列表】A. judicious  B. impetuous  C. reckless  D. precipitous
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：由 widely praised（廣受稱讚）與 safeguarded the firm's core balance sheet（捍衛了核心資產健全）可知，該決策受到極高之肯定，形容詞必為褒義，唯一正選為 judicious（審慎明智的、有見識的）。干擾項 impetuous（衝動魯莽的）、reckless（肆無忌憚的）、precipitous（倉促輕率的）皆為負面貶義詞，無法搭配 praised。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 明智的審慎的有見識的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「judicious」。單選精準考點：廣受稱讚之明智審慎決策選 judicious。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance
prompt: The academic dean’s address was notoriously ___, meandering for nearly two hours through irrelevant historical anecdotes without ever arriving at a coherent point.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位學術院長的大會致詞以「漫無邊際/東拉西扯冗長離題」而惡名昭彰，在無關痛癢的歷史軼事中兜兜轉轉了將近兩個小時，始終未能切入任何連貫的中心論點。
【選項列表】A. pointed  B. rambling  C. laconic  D. succinct
coreConcept: 單選考點分析：線索在於 notoriously（惡名昭彰地）與 meandering through irrelevant anecdotes without arriving at a coherent point（在無關軼事中漫遊離題兩小時且無中心論點），形容詞必為負面離題冗長之意，唯一正選為 rambling（漫無邊際東拉西扯的、冗長的）。干擾選項 pointed（針鋒相對尖銳直接的）、laconic（言簡意賅的）、succinct（簡短扼要的）皆為反義詞。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 漫無邊際的東拉西扯的雜亂的
尖銳的針對性強的尖利的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「rambling」。單選精準考點：冗長漫無邊際不著重點選 rambling。

courseHook.unitTitle: Text Completion: Scholarly Diction & Nuance 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Lexical Stylometry: Brevity vs. Prolixity
prompt: Renowned among colleagues for his extreme ___, the senior jurist rarely spoke during appellate oral arguments, yet his concise written opinions carried supreme authority.
translation:
【題幹精譯】在司法同仁心目中以極度「沉默寡言/言簡意賅」而聞名，這位資深大法官在上訴法庭口頭辯論期間極少開口，然而其精練至極的書面裁判書卻享有至高無上的權威。
【選項列表】A. loquacity  B. effusiveness  C. taciturnity  D. verbosity
coreConcept: rarely spoke 提示沉默寡言，名詞 taciturnity（沉默寡言、寡言少語）完美符合句意。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「taciturnity」。沉默寡言核心名詞選 taciturnity。

courseHook.unitTitle: Lexical Stylometry: Brevity vs. Prolixity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Lexical Stylometry: Brevity vs. Prolixity
prompt: The senator’s speech was marred by an insufferable ___; what could have been communicated in a concise five-minute briefing stretched into a tedious two-hour filibuster.
translation:
【題幹精譯】參議員的演說因令人難以忍受的「冗長囉唆廢話連篇」而遭到毀損；原本只需五分鐘簡報即可言簡意賅傳達的內容，竟被硬生生拉長成一場長達兩小時的枯燥議事拖延演說。
【選項列表】A. brevity  B. succinctness  C. economy  D. prolixity
coreConcept: what could have been concise... stretched into two hours 提示冗長囉唆，選 prolixity（冗長囉唆）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「prolixity」。冗長囉唆名詞選 prolixity。

courseHook.unitTitle: Lexical Stylometry: Brevity vs. Prolixity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Lexical Stylometry: Brevity vs. Prolixity
prompt: Spartan diplomatic envoys were legendary throughout classical Greece for their ___ responses, famously answering long-winded Macedonian threats with a single monosyllable: 'If.'
translation:
【題幹精譯】斯巴達外交特使在全希臘歷史上以其「言簡意賅/字字如金的」極簡回答而名垂青史，最著名者莫過於以一個單音節字『若』，斷然回擊馬其頓王國長篇大論的威脅恐嚇。
【選項列表】A. laconic  B. garrulous  C. voluble  D. circumlocutory
coreConcept: answering long-winded threats with a single word 提示極簡冷淡風格，選經典詞 laconic（簡短俐落的、斯巴達式的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 言簡意賅的寡言的簡約的
喋喋不休的多嘴的饒舌的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「laconic」。言簡意賅經典代表詞：laconic。

courseHook.unitTitle: Lexical Stylometry: Brevity vs. Prolixity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Lexical Stylometry: Brevity vs. Prolixity
prompt: The elderly innkeeper was a notoriously ___ conversationalist, eager to recount long, rambling anecdotes to any traveler unfortunate enough to ask for directions.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位老酒館掌櫃是個出了名「喋喋不休嘮叨多話的」健談者，極其熱衷於向任何不幸開口問路的外地旅客，巨細靡遺講述冗長散漫的陳年往事軼聞。
【選項列表】A. reticent  B. garrulous  C. curt  D. laconic
coreConcept: eager to recount long rambling anecdotes 提示多話愛嘮叨，選 garrulous（喋喋不休的、多嘴的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 喋喋不休的嘮叨的多嘴的
沉默寡言的含蓄的保留的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「garrulous」。多嘴多話形容詞選 garrulous。

courseHook.unitTitle: Lexical Stylometry: Brevity vs. Prolixity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Lexical Stylometry: Brevity vs. Prolixity
prompt: The editor praised the debut essayist for her prose style, noting that every paragraph displayed admirable verbal ___, devoid of decorative filler or empty padding.
translation:
【題幹精譯】主編盛讚這位初試啼聲之專欄作家的散文風格，指出其每一個段落均展現出令人欽佩的文字「精準精練/凝練克制」，完全沒有任何浮誇的裝飾性贅詞或空洞填塞物。
【選項列表】A. prodigality  B. superfluity  C. economy  D. tautology
coreConcept: devoid of decorative filler 提示字句精練克制，選 verbal economy（語言的凝練經濟）。
