【選項列表】A. extinction  B. asceticism  C. flourishing  D. mortification
coreConcept: Aristotle's eudaimonia is translated as human flourishing（人類繁榮、至善境界）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「flourishing」。美德倫理學核心專有名詞選 flourishing。

courseHook.unitTitle: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism
prompt: The 'trolley problem' thought experiment illustrates the ethical tension between utilitarian maximization and deontological ___ against actively taking a life.
translation:
【題幹精譯】著名的『電車難題』思想實驗，生動具象化了功利主義人數最大化計算，與義務論嚴格禁止主動奪取他人性命的絕對道德「禁令/義務戒律」之間所爆發的劇烈倫理衝突。
【選項列表】A. mandates  B. permissions  C. incentives  D. prohibitions
coreConcept: deontological prohibitions against taking a life（義務論禁止殺戮之絕對禁令）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「prohibitions」。道德禁令名詞選 prohibitions。

courseHook.unitTitle: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism
prompt: Ethical egoism claims that an action is morally right if and only if it maximizes the agent’s own long-term ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】利己主義倫理學大膽主張：某一項具體行為當且僅當能夠最大化實現行為主體自身的長期「自身利益/自我利益」之時，其在道德上才是正當合理的。
【選項列表】A. self-interest  B. altruism  C. benevolence  D. sacrifice
coreConcept: ethical egoism maximizes the agent's self-interest（倫理利己主義最大化自利）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 自私自利個人利益自身利益

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「self-interest」。自利核心專有名詞選 self-interest。

courseHook.unitTitle: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism
prompt: John Rawls’s concept of the 'veil of ignorance' requires hypothetical legislators to design principles of justice without knowing their own social class, wealth, or natural ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】約翰·羅爾斯的『無知之幕』思想實驗要求，虛擬假設的社會契約立法者在擬定正義基本原則時，必須完全不知道自己未來的社會階級地位、財富多寡或天賦個人「才智才華資質」。
【選項列表】A. debts  B. talents  C. penalties  D. crimes
coreConcept: Rawls: veil of ignorance blinds individuals to class, wealth, or natural talents/endowments。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「talents」。天賦資質名詞選 talents。

courseHook.unitTitle: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism
prompt: Moral relativists argue that ethical standards are culturally contingent constructs devoid of any objective, universal ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】道德相對主義者堅持認為，一切倫理價值標準純屬隨文化歷史情境而變遷的偶然建構物，完全缺乏任何放諸四海皆準的客觀、普遍「有效性/真理正當性」。
【選項列表】A. prejudice  B. bias  C. validity  D. subjectivity
coreConcept: standards are contingent constructs devoid of universal validity（缺乏普遍有效性）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「validity」。有效性名詞選 validity。

courseHook.unitTitle: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism
prompt: Existentialist philosopher Jean-Paul Sartre argued that because humans possess radical freedom, attempts to evade moral responsibility by claiming deterministic constraint constitute 'bad ___.'
translation:
【題幹精譯】存在主義哲學家尚-保羅·沙特論證指出，正因人類享有絕對徹底的自由選擇權，任何企圖藉由聲稱命運決定論約束來逃避個人道德承擔責任的藉口作態，均構成了所謂的『自欺/不誠「信(bad faith)」』。
【選項列表】A. karma  B. conscience  C. virtue  D. faith
coreConcept: Sartre: evading moral responsibility is bad faith (mauvaise foi)（自欺欺人）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 存在主義的存在主義者

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「faith」。存在主義專有名詞選 faith（構成 bad faith）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism
prompt: The moral philosopher criticized divine command theory, invoking Socrates's ancient *Euthyphro* dilemma: is an action pious because the gods love it, or do the gods love it because it is ___ pious?
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位道德哲學家嚴厲批駁了神命論，重新引述了蘇格拉底在《尤西弗羅篇》中的千古兩難困境：某一行為究竟是因為受到神明喜愛才成為虔誠善良，抑或是因為其本身在實質上「本質地/內在地」就是善良虔誠，神明才因而喜愛之？
【選項列表】A. inherently  B. superficially  C. arbitrarily  D. accidentally
coreConcept: Euthyphro dilemma: loved because pious, or inherently pious?（本質上為善）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「inherently」。本質固有副詞選 inherently。

courseHook.unitTitle: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism
prompt: Contractarian ethics, tracing from Thomas Hobbes, grounds moral duty not in cosmic metaphysics, but in a mutually advantageous social ___ among self-interested individuals.
translation:
【題幹精譯】溯源自湯瑪斯·霍布斯的契約論倫理學體系，並未將道德義務奠基於縹緲的宇宙形上學之中，而是將其建立在一群追求自利的理性個體之間所達成之互惠互利社會「契約/公約」基礎之上。
【選項列表】A. sentiment  B. contract  C. intuition  D. prayer
coreConcept: contractarian ethics grounds duty in a social contract（社會契約論）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「contract」。契約核心名詞選 contract。

courseHook.unitTitle: Moral Philosophy: Deontology & Utilitarianism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: Geologists propose formally designating the contemporary epoch the 'Anthropocene' to reflect the reality that human industrial activity has become the dominant global geological ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】地質學家正式倡議將當代地質紀元命名為『人類世(Anthropocene)』，旨在如實反映人類的現代工業活動已然躍居成為主宰地球全球系統運轉的核心地質「營力/地質力量」。
【選項列表】A. metaphor  B. illusion  C. force  D. anomaly
coreConcept: human activity is the dominant geological force (Anthropocene definition)。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「force」。地質營力專有名詞選 force。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: The removal of apex predators like wolves triggers an ecological cascade that leads to the rapid ___ of biodiversity across entire river valleys.
translation:
【題幹精譯】諸如灰狼等食物鏈頂端頂級捕食者的驟然消失，將會觸發嚴重的生態營養級連鎖反應，直接導致整個河流流域內部生物多樣性遭遇不可逆轉之急遽「枯竭耗盡/銳減破壞」。
【選項列表】A. augmentation  B. perfection  C. elevation  D. depletion
coreConcept: removal of apex predators causes depletion of biodiversity（多樣性枯竭）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「depletion」。枯竭消耗名詞選 depletion。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: Ecosystem 'resilience' describes the capacity of a natural ecological biome to absorb external disturbances and reorganize while still retaining essentially the same function and ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】生態系統的『韌性/恢復力(resilience)』，係指自然生物群落吸收抵禦外部環境衝擊干擾並進行自我重組調適的能力，且在此動態過程中依然能本質性地維持其核心生態功能與總體「結構/架構網絡」。
【選項列表】A. structure  B. stagnation  C. inertia  D. extinction
coreConcept: resilience is capacity to absorb disturbance while retaining function and structure。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 生物群落生物區生物地理群

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「structure」。生態系統結構名詞選 structure。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: The widespread drainage of peatlands for palm oil agriculture releases gigatons of sequestered carbon, transforming these vital biomes from carbon sinks into carbon ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】為開闢油棕種植園而對天然泥炭地進行的大規模排乾開墾，釋放了數十億噸原先深鎖地下的封存碳素，將這些極關鍵的生態系統徹底從碳匯轉變成為了向大氣狂排溫室氣體的碳「源/排放源頭」。
【選項列表】A. vaults  B. sources  C. deposits  D. reserves
coreConcept: drainage transforms peatlands from carbon sinks into carbon sources（碳匯變碳源）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「sources」。碳源反義名詞選 sources。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: Ocean acidification, driven by the oceanic absorption of anthropogenic carbon dioxide, severely inhibits the calcification rates of marine ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】由海洋吸收人類工業活動排放之二氧化碳所直接推動引發的海水酸化危機，極其嚴重地阻礙與抑制了包括造礁珊瑚與有殼浮游生物在內之海洋「生物體/鈣化生物」的碳酸鈣外殼鈣化速率。
【選項列表】A. atmospheres  B. glaciers  C. organisms  D. volcanoes
coreConcept: ocean acidification inhibits calcification of marine organisms（抑制海洋生物鈣化）。

vocabulary.meaning: 人為的人類活動引起的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「organisms」。海洋生物名詞選 organisms。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: Environmental ethicists advocate the 'precautionary principle,' arguing that in the face of potentially catastrophic ecological hazards, scientific uncertainty should not justify ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】環境倫理學家極力倡導『預防原則』，嚴正指出在面對可能引發災難性嚴重生態危害的威脅面前，科學認知上暫時存在之不確定性，絕不應成為政策上藉故「無所作為/消極怠惰拖延」的合理藉口。
【選項列表】A. regulation  B. intervention  C. vigilance  D. inaction
coreConcept: precautionary principle: scientific uncertainty should not justify inaction（不確定性不可成為怠惰理由）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 無作為不作為遲疑消極

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「inaction」。消極怠惰名詞選 inaction。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: The critical threshold beyond which an ecosystem shifts irreversibly into a qualitatively different structural state is known as an ecological ___ point.
translation:
【題幹精譯】生態系統一旦跨越後便會發生不可逆轉之相變、進而徹底滑向截然不同的全新退化結構狀態之臨界門檻，在地球科學中被嚴密定義為生態「引爆點/臨界翻轉點(tipping point)」。
【選項列表】A. tipping  B. freezing  C. boiling  D. resting
coreConcept: critical threshold beyond which shift is irreversible is a tipping point（臨界翻轉點）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 引爆點臨界點臨界翻轉點

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「tipping」。臨界翻轉點核心形容詞選 tipping。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: Microplastic particles have permeated even the most remote abyssal trenches, serving as pervasive markers of anthropogenic ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】微塑膠顆粒如今甚至已徹底滲透蔓延至最偏遠孤立的深海萬米深淵海溝，成為了人類工業文明所造成之全球無所不在「環境污染」的不可磨滅之實質印記。
【選項列表】A. purification  B. pollution  C. restoration  D. sanitation
coreConcept: microplastics serve as markers of anthropogenic pollution（人為污染標記）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「pollution」。污染名詞選 pollution。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: Conservation biologists emphasize that establishing contiguous wildlife corridors is essential to counteract the destructive demographic impacts of habitat ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】保育生物學家反覆強調，在破碎景觀中重新建構起連綿不斷的野生動物生態廊道，對於有效抵禦與扭轉棲息地「破碎化/割裂隔離」對野生種群所造成之毀滅性基因衰退衝擊至關重要。
【選項列表】A. expansion  B. preservation  C. fragmentation  D. reforestation
coreConcept: corridors counteract the impacts of habitat fragmentation（生態廊道對沖棲地破碎化）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 相鄰的連續的未中斷的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「fragmentation」。棲地破碎化專有名詞選 fragmentation。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience
prompt: The 'tragedy of the commons' describes how uncoordinated, rational individual actors deplete a shared open-access resource, ultimately causing collective ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】『公地悲劇』深刻剖析了各自為政且自詡理性的個別行動者，如何在自由取用無排他性之公共資源體系中各自過度索取消耗，最終無可避免地導致整個社群走向集體的「毀滅/崩潰破產」。
【選項列表】A. wealth  B. prosperity  C. optimization  D. ruin
coreConcept: tragedy of the commons: individuals deplete resources causing collective ruin（公地悲劇導致集體毀滅）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「ruin」。集體毀滅名詞選 ruin。

courseHook.unitTitle: Environmental Science: Anthropocene & Resilience 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: The radical interpretation of the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis, known as linguistic determinism, claims that language strictly ___ the cognitive boundaries of human thought.
translation:
【題幹精譯】沙皮爾-沃爾夫假說最極端的理論解讀版本——即語言決定論——大膽宣稱：母語語言架構「嚴厲束縛與禁錮鎖定了」人類大腦認知思考思維的極限邊界。
【選項列表】A. constrains  B. expands  C. dissolves  D. liberates
coreConcept: linguistic determinism: language strictly constrains thought（語言嚴格約束思維邊界）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「constrains」。限制約束動詞選 constrains。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: Historical linguists study 'semantic drift,' tracing how a word’s meaning can undergo radical ___ over centuries, sometimes evolving into its precise opposite.
translation:
【題幹精譯】歷史語言學家致力於深入考證『語意漂變』現象，系統性梳理單字詞彙的內在含義如何在漫長世紀更迭中歷經激烈的「轉變突變/演化轉移」，甚至不可思議地逐步演化成為其最初本義的完全反義詞。
【選項列表】A. stagnation  B. mutation  C. fossilization  D. rigidity
coreConcept: undergo radical mutation/evolution into its opposite（突變演化為反義）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「mutation」。語意轉變突變名詞選 mutation。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: Chomsky’s theory of Universal Grammar challenged behaviorist models by positing an ___ language acquisition device hardwired into the human neural architecture.
translation:
【題幹精譯】喬姆斯基的普遍語法學說向行為主義學習理論發起了根本性挑戰，提出人類大腦神經架構內部深植著一套「天生的/與生俱來的」語言習得機制(LAD)。
【選項列表】A. acquired  B. ephemeral  C. innate  D. arbitrary
coreConcept: Universal Grammar posits an innate language acquisition device（天賦語言習得機制）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 行為主義的行為學派的
天生的與生俱來的固有的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「innate」。天賦天生形容詞選 innate。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: The process of 'pejoration' in historical semantics occurs when a neutral or positive term acquires an overtly ___ connotation over historical usage.
translation:
【題幹精譯】在歷史語意學研究領域，當一個原本在中性或褒義語境中使用的詞彙，在歷經長時間的演變沉澱後逐漸沾染上強烈「貶損蔑視/負面貶義的」隱含負面涵義時，這種現象被稱為詞義貶降。
【選項列表】A. laudatory  B. reverent  C. complimentary  D. derogatory
coreConcept: pejoration: term acquires an overtly derogatory/pejorative connotation（詞義貶降）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「derogatory」。貶損貶義形容詞選 derogatory。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: Ferdinand de Saussure emphasized the ___ nature of the linguistic sign, arguing that there is no inherent natural connection between a word and its referent.
translation:
【題幹精譯】現代語言學之父斐迪南·德·索緒爾深刻強調了語言符號本質上的「任意性/約定俗成性」，堅定論證指出在語言文字的語音符號與其所指代的外部實體事物之間，根本不存在任何天然本質的必然聯繫。
【選項列表】A. arbitrary  B. intrinsic  C. immutable  D. deterministic
coreConcept: Saussure: the linguistic sign is arbitrary (no inherent connection)。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 任意的武斷的專斷的約定俗成的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「arbitrary」。語言符號任意性核心名詞選 arbitrary。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: Sociolinguists analyze 'code-switching' to demonstrate how multilingual speakers navigate divergent social spheres by shifting between linguistic ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】社會語言學家深入剖析『語碼轉換』現象，旨在生動揭示多語言使用者如何藉由在不同語言層次與「語體風格/語域(registers)」之間從容自如地來回切換，在不同社會文化圈層中遊刃有餘地穿梭溝通。
【選項列表】A. pathologies  B. registers  C. limitations  D. stagnations
coreConcept: shifting between linguistic registers（在不同語言語域/語體間切換）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「registers」。語言語域專有名詞選 registers。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: Historical linguists reconstructed Proto-Indo-European by applying the comparative method, identifying systematic phonetic correspondences across ___ languages.
translation:
【題幹精譯】歷史比較語言學家藉由嚴格運用語言比較分析法，在廣大印歐語系內部各「同源/同根生出之」語言之間精準梳理出系統性的語音對應律，進而奇蹟般地重構出了未曾留存文字的原始印歐語形態。
【選項列表】A. incompatible  B. unrelated  C. cognate  D. invented
coreConcept: identifying systematic correspondences across cognate languages（在同源語言間建立語音對應）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「cognate」。同源語言專業形容詞選 cognate。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: Linguistic relativity experiments demonstrate that speakers of languages with gendered nouns consistently assign masculine or feminine ___ to inanimate objects.
translation:
【題幹精譯】當代語言相對論系列認知實驗表明，母語名詞具備陰陽性語法性別區分的語言使用者，在心理想像中會始終如一地將相應的男性化或女性化「性格特徵/屬性特質」投射賦予給毫無生命的無機物體。
【選項列表】A. flaws  B. deficits  C. mutations  D. attributes
coreConcept: assign masculine or feminine attributes to objects（賦予屬性特質）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「attributes」。屬性特質名詞選 attributes。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: The lexical gap hypothesis suggests that when a culture lacks a single word for a nuanced emotional state, it may indicate a different cultural ___ of that experience.
translation:
【題幹精譯】『詞彙空缺假說』啟示我們：當某種語言文化在詞彙庫中完全缺乏用以精確描繪某種細微情感狀態的單一對應詞彙時，這往往暗示著該文化對那種情感體驗存在著截然不同之文化「概念化認知構建方式」。
【選項列表】A. conceptualization  B. extinction  C. annihilation  D. paralysis
coreConcept: lexical gap indicates a different cultural conceptualization of experience。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 具有細微差別的微妙的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「conceptualization」。概念化建構名詞選 conceptualization。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift
prompt: Morphological typology classifies human languages based on how words are formed, distinguishing isolating languages from highly ___ polysynthetic tongues.
translation:
【題幹精譯】形態類型學根據詞彙的構詞內部機制對全人類語言進行科學分類，清晰區分出孤立語與高度「黏著的/膠著性的(agglutinative)」多式綜合語。
【選項列表】A. inarticulate  B. agglutinative  C. monosyllabic  D. mute
coreConcept: distinguishing isolating languages from agglutinative and polysynthetic tongues。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「agglutinative」。語言形態學黏著語專用詞選 agglutinative。

courseHook.unitTitle: Linguistic Relativity: Sapir-Whorf & Drift 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: Constitutional originalists argue that judicial interpretation must be strictly anchored in the original public ___ of the text at the time of its ratification.
translation:
【題幹精譯】憲法原旨主義者堅定主張，司法機關對憲法法條的詮釋與裁決，必須無條件嚴格錨定在法條文本於當初獲得批准簽署之歷史時刻所具備之『原始公眾「客觀意涵」』基礎之上。
【選項列表】A. evolution  B. ambiguity  C. meaning  D. rejection
coreConcept: originalism: anchored in original public meaning at time of ratification。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 原旨主義者原意主義者

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「meaning」。原旨主義核心名詞選 meaning。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: The doctrine of *stare decisis* mandates that appellate courts adhere to established legal ___, ensuring consistency and stability across judicial rulings.
translation:
【題幹精譯】普通法系中舉足輕重的『遵循先例原則(*stare decisis*)』強制規範要求，上訴法院必須嚴格尊重並恪遵既有的司法判決「先例/既成判例」，藉以確保整個司法裁決體系的一致性、權威性與可預期之穩定性。
【選項列表】A. anarchies  B. speculations  C. whims  D. precedents
coreConcept: stare decisis mandates adherence to established legal precedents（遵循先例）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 遵循先例原則判例法原則

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「precedents」。司法判例複數名詞選 precedents。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: Legal realists challenged formalism by arguing that judicial outcomes are not deduced mechanically from pure legal logic, but are shaped by judges' conscious or subconscious political ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】法律現實主義法學派向傳統法律形式主義發起了強烈挑戰，論證指出法官的司法判決裁定絕非從純粹法學邏輯中機械演繹推導而來，反而是深受法官個人有意識或潛意識中的政治「偏好/價值取向偏愛」所深刻塑造。
【選項列表】A. predilections  B. infallibilities  C. omnisciences  D. paralyses
coreConcept: judicial outcomes are shaped by judges' political predilections/biases。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「predilections」。政治傾向偏好名詞選 predilections。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: Advocates of the 'Living Constitution' doctrine contend that constitutional jurisprudence must evolve dynamically to address unprecedented technological and social ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】『活的憲法』學說的堅定擁護者論證主張，憲法法理學的解釋必須隨時代脈動動態演進革新，唯有如此方能妥善應對現代社會前所未見的尖端科技變革與社會結構「巨變轉型」。
【選項列表】A. stagnations  B. transformations  C. regressions  D. petrifications
coreConcept: jurisprudence must evolve to address technological transformations（應對時代轉型變革）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「transformations」。巨變轉型複數名詞選 transformations。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: In his landmark dissent, the justice warned that the majority’s activist ruling constituted an unconstitutional usurpation of legislative authority by the ___ branch.
translation:
【題幹精譯】在這篇載入史冊的劃時代少數異議裁判書中，該大法官嚴厲警告指出，多數派法官的司法能動主義裁決，已然構成了「司法」權力對立憲國會立法權力徹頭徹尾的違憲僭越與霸凌侵奪。
【選項列表】A. executive  B. foreign  C. judicial  D. tribal
coreConcept: judicial usurpation of legislative authority（司法權僭越立法權）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「judicial」。司法權形容詞選 judicial。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: Natural law theorists maintain that human-made statutes that violate foundational universal human rights lack genuine moral legitimacy and are not truly ___ law.
translation:
【題幹精譯】自然法學派理論家堅定主張，任何公然踐踏牴觸基礎普世人權的世俗實定制定成文法規，根本喪失了最起碼的道德正當合法性，因而不能被視為在道德良知上真正具備「約束力的/合法效力的」真正法律。
【選項列表】A. corrupt  B. tyrannical  C. arbitrary  D. binding
coreConcept: unjust law lacks moral legitimacy and is not truly binding law（惡法非法、無約束力）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 具約束力的有法律效力的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「binding」。法律約束力形容詞選 binding。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: Legal positivists insist on the strict separation of law and morality, asserting that the validity of a legal statute depends exclusively on its pedigree of sovereign ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】法律實證主義者嚴格堅持將法律與道德予以涇渭分明之清晰切割，斷言某一法律條文之有效性與否，純粹取決於其是否出自最高主權公權力之合法法定「頒布施行/正式立法程序」。
【選項列表】A. enactment  B. subversion  C. defiance  D. rebellion
coreConcept: positivism: legal validity depends on sovereign enactment/promulgation。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「enactment」。法律頒布實施名詞選 enactment。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: The principle of *habeas corpus* serves as an indispensable constitutional bulwark against arbitrary and indefinite executive ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】『人身保護令(*habeas corpus*)』的根本司法原則，充當了一道不可或缺的憲政防禦堅固堡壘，堅決捍衛公民免遭行政掌權者任意且無期限之非法「扣押羈押/非法拘禁」。
【選項列表】A. liberation  B. detention  C. enfranchisement  D. election
coreConcept: habeas corpus protects against arbitrary executive detention（人身保護令防範非法拘留）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 人身保護令狀人身保護法
拘留扣押監禁留校察看

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「detention」。拘留羈押名詞選 detention。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: The Supreme Court overturned the century-old precedent, explicitly declaring that separate educational facilities based on race are 'inherently ___.'
translation:
【題幹精譯】聯邦最高法院在一項劃時代判決中斷然推翻了長達一世紀的司法判例，旗幟鮮明地正式宣告指出：任何基於種族實施隔離的公立教育設施，在根本實質上都是『天生「不平等」的』。
【選項列表】A. harmonious  B. identical  C. unequal  D. egalitarian
coreConcept: Brown v. Board of Education: separate educational facilities are inherently unequal。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「unequal」。平等否定詞選 unequal。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism
prompt: Substantive due process protects fundamental constitutional liberties against legislative overreach, even if the challenged statutes are procedurally ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】實質性正當法律程序原則，旨在捍衛憲法所保障之公民核心根本自由權利免遭立法權力的越權肆意侵害，即便那些遭受憲法審查質疑的爭議法案在形式立法程序上顯得「毫無瑕疵/完全合乎程序」。
【選項列表】A. corrupt  B. unconstitutional  C. tyrannical  D. flawless
coreConcept: substantive due process protects rights even if statutes are procedurally flawless/correct。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 實質的實體法的重要的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「flawless」。程序完美形容詞選 flawless。

courseHook.unitTitle: Legal Theory: Jurisprudence & Originalism 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: The second law of thermodynamics dictates that in any isolated system, total ___ must irreversibly increase over time, driving the universe toward eventual thermal equilibrium.
translation:
【題幹精譯】熱力學第二定律鐵律般明文規定：在任何與外界隔絕之封閉隔離系統內部，系統的總體「熵值/混亂度(entropy)」必然會隨時間推移而不可逆地單向持續遞增，最終驅使整個宇宙步向終極熱寂均衡熱平衡死寂。
【選項列表】A. entropy  B. energy  C. velocity  D. gravity
coreConcept: second law of thermodynamics: entropy must irreversibly increase over time（熵增定律）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「entropy」。熱力學核心專有名詞選 entropy。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: Because dark matter does not interact with the electromagnetic force, it remains completely invisible to optical and radio telescopes, revealing its presence exclusively through ___ effects.
translation:
【題幹精譯】正因為暗物質完全不與任何電磁力發生交互作用，它在光學與射電電波望遠鏡的視野中始終處於絕對不可見之隱形狀態，僅僅只能透過其所施加之「萬有引力/重力牽引」效應向世人揭示其龐大客觀存在。
【選項列表】A. thermal  B. gravitational  C. chemical  D. auditory
coreConcept: dark matter reveals presence exclusively through gravitational effects（引力效應）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 引力的重力的地心吸力的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「gravitational」。引力重力形容詞選 gravitational。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: The 'fine-tuning' problem in cosmology asks why the fundamental physical constants of our universe fall within the razor-thin margin necessary to permit the emergence of conscious ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】宇宙學中最著名的『微調疑難』向全體理論物理學家提出叩問：為何我們宇宙所存在之基本物理常數數值，竟然如此巧合地精準落在容許有意識之「生命體」得以孕育誕生的極度嚴苛、薄如刀鋒般之微小容許區間之內？
【選項列表】A. entropy  B. vacuum  C. life  D. radiation
coreConcept: fine-tuning problem: constants fall in margin permitting emergence of conscious life。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「life」。意識生命名詞選 life。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: Inflationary cosmological theory posits an epoch of exponential spatial expansion a fraction of a second after the Big Bang, resolving the flatness and ___ paradoxes.
translation:
【題幹精譯】暴脹宇宙學學說假定，在宇宙大爆炸爆發後僅僅幾分之一秒的極短瞬間，空間結構經歷了一場呈指數級極遽膨脹擴張的暴脹時期，從而一舉徹底解決了宇宙平坦性疑難與「視界/宇宙學視界」悖論難題。
【選項列表】A. entropy  B. neutrino  C. pulsar  D. horizon
coreConcept: cosmic inflation resolves the flatness and horizon problems/paradoxes。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「horizon」。宇宙學視界名詞選 horizon。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: Some theoretical physicists invoke the 'multiverse' hypothesis, proposing that our observable cosmos is merely one bubble within an infinite, eternally expanding quantum ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】部分前瞻理論物理學家引入了『多重宇宙』假說，大膽提出我們目前所能觀測到的浩瀚可觀測宇宙，只不過是在一個無限延伸、永恆膨脹之微觀量子「泡沫(quantum foam)」體系當中的一顆微不足道之局部氣泡罷了。
【選項列表】A. foam  B. solid  C. crystal  D. monolith
coreConcept: infinite eternally expanding quantum foam/multiverse（量子泡沫多重宇宙）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「foam」。量子泡沫專用名詞選 foam。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: The ultimate fate of an ever-expanding universe, characterized by the decay of all atomic matter and the evaporation of black holes via Hawking radiation, is termed the 'heat ___.'
translation:
【題幹精譯】隨著宇宙的無休止加速膨脹，當所有原子重子物質最終衰變殆盡、且所有巨型黑洞亦透過霍金輻射緩慢蒸發殆盡之時，宇宙所邁向之終極冰冷死寂宿命被天文物理學界沉痛命名為『熱「寂/熱死亡(heat death)」』。
【選項列表】A. birth  B. death  C. rebound  D. compression
coreConcept: ultimate fate of ever-expanding universe is the heat death（熱寂）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「death」。熱寂專有名詞選 death。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: Dark energy, which accounts for roughly sixty-eight percent of total cosmic energy density, exerts a repulsive pressure that accelerates cosmic ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】佔據了全宇宙總體質能密度約達百分之六十八之神秘暗能量，在其大尺度空間結構中施加著一種反向排斥性負壓，從而正在持續不可阻擋地全面加速著整個宇宙的「膨脹擴張進程」。
【選項列表】A. contraction  B. implosion  C. expansion  D. crystallization
coreConcept: dark energy exerts repulsive pressure accelerating cosmic expansion（暗能量加速宇宙膨脹）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 排斥的斥力的令人厭惡的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「expansion」。宇宙膨脹名詞選 expansion。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: Cosmic microwave background radiation represents the cooled electromagnetic relic of the primeval fireball, decoupling from baryonic matter approximately 380,000 years after the ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】宇宙微波背景輻射代表著遠古原始大爆炸熾熱火球冷卻遺留下來之電磁遺跡殘光，它是在宇宙大爆炸最初始之引力「奇異點/奇點」誕生爆發後約三十八萬年之際，首次自重子常規物質中退耦分離而出。
【選項列表】A. extinction  B. evaporation  C. decay  D. singularity
coreConcept: cooling relic decoupling 380,000 years after the initial singularity/Big Bang。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 奇點奇異點奇特性獨特性

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「singularity」。宇宙奇點專有名詞選 singularity。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: Astrophysicists deduce the existence of supermassive black holes at galactic centers from the relativistic orbital velocities of nearby stars and the emission of high-energy accretion ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】天體物理學家根據鄰近恆星所展現出之相對論性極高軌道旋轉速度，以及核心吸積盤所噴射噴發出之高能相對論性電漿「噴流/吸積噴射束」，無可辯駁地推斷出各星系中央必然盤踞著超大質量黑洞實體。
【選項列表】A. jets  B. clouds  C. dust  D. planets
coreConcept: emission of high-energy accretion jets（高能吸積噴流）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「jets」。噴流專有名詞選 jets。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy
prompt: The anthropic principle cautions cosmologists against surprise regarding our finely-tuned constants, noting that our very presence as observers logically requires a universe compatible with our ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】人擇原理嚴正提醒天體物理學家，切莫對我們身處之宇宙其物理常數之精準微調感到過度詫異與困惑，因為我們作為觀測者能夠在此進行思索探討的客觀前提，在形式邏輯上便嚴格倒逼要求：這個宇宙的物理規律必須完全與我們自身的「客觀存在」相容並蓄。
【選項列表】A. extinction  B. existence  C. annihilation  D. collapse
coreConcept: anthropic principle: observer presence logically requires compatibility with our existence。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 人類的人擇的人類的起源的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「existence」。存在名詞選 existence。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cosmological Theories: Multiverse & Entropy 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: The discovery of adult neuroplasticity overturned the long-standing neurological dogma that the mature mammalian brain is structurally fixed and incapable of architectural ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】成年大腦神經可塑性的重大科學發現，徹底推翻了神經學界長期信奉的傳統教條，該教條原本斷言發育成熟的哺乳動物大腦在結構上已完全定型硬化、絕對無法在微觀架構上展開任何結構性「重組再生與網絡重構」。
【選項列表】A. stagnation  B. petrification  C. reorganization  D. paralysis
coreConcept: neuroplasticity proves the mature brain is capable of reorganization（大腦能夠進行神經網絡重組）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 神經可塑性大腦可塑性

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「reorganization」。重組成架構名詞選 reorganization。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: The philosophical 'hard problem of consciousness,' formulated by David Chalmers, asks how subjective phenomenal experiences, known as qualia, arise from objective physical ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】由哲學家大衛·查默斯所提出的著名意識『困難問題』，向認知科學提出了終極哲學拷問：究竟主觀的現象學感官體驗——即所謂的感質(qualia)——是如何從客觀純物質的物理大腦生理「生化進程與神經過程」中神奇湧現孕育而出的？
【選項列表】A. metaphors  B. myths  C. illusions  D. processes
coreConcept: hard problem asks how subjective qualia arise from physical processes。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 感質主觀體驗感覺特徵

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「processes」。物理神經進程複數名詞選 processes。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: Cognitive neuroscientists studying split-brain patients demonstrated that severing the corpus callosum creates two largely independent spheres of conscious ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】深入研究裂腦症病患的認知神經科學家雄辯地證實，藉由外科手術完全切斷連接大腦左右半球的胼胝體，實際上會在單一人體顱內創造出兩個在很大程度上彼此隔絕、獨立運作的意識「知覺感知體驗領域」。
【選項列表】A. awareness  B. amnesia  C. insensibility  D. paralysis
coreConcept: severing corpus callosum creates independent spheres of conscious awareness/consciousness。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「awareness」。意識知覺名詞選 awareness。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: Blind individuals who read braille exhibit functional reorganization, as their visual cortex is recruited to process tactile sensory ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】透過手指觸摸盲文點字進行閱讀的視障盲人群體展現出了驚人的跨模態功能重組重構：其原先專司視覺的大腦枕葉視覺皮層，竟被深度徵調挪用來高效處理來自指尖的複雜觸覺感知「感官輸入訊號」。
【選項列表】A. illusions  B. inputs  C. deficits  D. damages
coreConcept: visual cortex processes tactile sensory inputs（觸覺感官輸入）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「inputs」。輸入訊號名詞選 inputs。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) does not track neuronal firing directly, but rather measures localized changes in blood oxygenation as a ___ for metabolic activity.
translation:
【題幹精譯】功能性磁振造影(fMRI)技術在原理上並無法直接即時追蹤神經元突觸的電脈衝點火發放，而是透過精確測量局部腦區血氧水平濃度的微細動態漲落，作為推斷腦區代謝神經活性的間接「替代代理指標/指標代表」。
【選項列表】A. barrier  B. deterrent  C. proxy  D. negation
coreConcept: measures blood oxygenation as a proxy for neural activity（替代代理測量指標）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 代理人代理權替代指標代表

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「proxy」。代理指標專有名詞選 proxy。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: Patients suffering from damage to Broca’s area typically experience non-fluent aphasia, characterized by halting speech production despite intact linguistic ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】左額下回布羅卡區(Broca's area)遭受器質性損傷中風的失語症病患，通常會罹患運動性非流暢型失語症，其典型臨床特徵為言語發音產出極其吃力中斷停滯，然而其對語言文字的內在理解「聽讀理解領會能力」卻維持得相當完好無損。
【選項列表】A. paralysis  B. blindness  C. deafness  D. comprehension
coreConcept: halting speech despite intact comprehension（發音受損但理解完好）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「comprehension」。理解力名詞選 comprehension。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: Neuroscientists studying synaptogenesis emphasize that during critical developmental windows, the infant brain undergoes massive synaptic pruning to eliminate redundant neural ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】深入研究突觸發生學的神經科學家強調指出，在生命早期的關鍵發育敏感窗口期內，嬰幼兒大腦會展開極大規模的神經突觸修剪修飾作業，藉以果斷剔除冗餘無效的神經「連結通路與突觸突起」。
【選項列表】A. connections  B. cells  C. tumors  D. toxins
coreConcept: synaptic pruning eliminates redundant neural connections（突觸修剪剔除冗餘連結）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「connections」。神經連結複數名詞選 connections。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: The 'rubber hand illusion' reveals that human body ownership is remarkably malleable, demonstrating that sensory integration can fool the brain into adopting an artificial ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】著名的『橡膠手錯覺』實驗驚人地揭示出，人類對自身肉體歸屬感的本體感覺知覺具有極強的可塑性與易受欺騙性，生動證明多感官同步刺激整合足以欺騙大腦，使其主動將一隻虛假的塑料義肢誤認納入為自身真實的「肢體肢節」。
【選項列表】A. voice  B. limb  C. eye  D. memory
coreConcept: rubber hand illusion tricks brain into adopting an artificial limb（採納假肢為自身肢體）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 可塑的易受影響的具延展性的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「limb」。肢體專有名詞選 limb。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: Epigenetic studies demonstrate that severe early-life maternal deprivation can alter chromatin architecture in the hippocampus, leaving lasting molecular scars that impair stress ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】表觀遺傳學前沿實證研究表明，哺乳動物幼年早期遭受嚴重的母愛剝奪與心理創傷，能夠直接改變海馬體內部染色質的立體三維結構封裝，留下永久性的分子生物學表觀疤痕，從而長期損害其成年後的壓力「調控調節與抗壓因應機制」。
【選項列表】A. escalation  B. inflation  C. regulation  D. multiplication
coreConcept: alterations impair stress regulation（損害壓力調節能力）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 表觀遺傳的表觀遺傳學的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「regulation」。調節調控名詞選 regulation。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity
prompt: The vegetative state presents profound ethical conundrums, as patients display sleep-wake cycles while remaining completely devoid of behavioral evidence of self-___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】植物人持續性植物狀態向當代醫學倫理界拋出了極其沉痛深邃的兩難困局：病患雖然依然維持著正常的晝夜睡眠-清醒生物節律週期，然而其外在行為舉止卻完全徹底喪失了任何能夠證明其具備主觀自我「知覺與自覺意識」的生命跡象。
【選項列表】A. respiration  B. circulation  C. digestion  D. awareness
coreConcept: devoid of evidence of self-awareness（完全喪失自我意識）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「awareness」。自我意識專用名詞選 self-awareness。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cognitive Neuroscience: Neuroplasticity 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: The historian’s monograph was condemned for degenerating into an acrimonious ___, sacrificing archival nuance in a partisan crusade against his academic rivals.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該歷史學家的學術專著因墮落演變成一篇充滿尖酸刻薄火藥味的「爭論檄文/論戰攻擊性文章」而遭到學術界的普遍譴責，指責其為了對學術政敵展開黨同伐異的十字軍討伐，而不惜犧牲檔案史料原有的幽微細緻脈絡。
【選項列表】A. polemic  B. panegyric  C. consensus  D. harmony
coreConcept: sacrificing nuance in a partisan crusade degenerates into an acrimonious polemic。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 論戰檄文爭論激烈爭辯

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「polemic」。論戰檄文核心名詞選 polemic。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: In stark contrast to the venomous diatribes of his contemporaries, Erasmus composed an ___ dialogue that sought to reconcile warring theological factions through mutual concession.
translation:
【題幹精譯】與其同時代文人所撰寫的那些毒汁四濺的謾罵痛斥文章形成鮮明反差，伊拉斯謨親自撰寫了一篇秉持「和平主義的/促進和解和睦的」寬厚對話錄，力求透過雙方互諒互讓來調和化解當時兵戎相見的各大神學對立教派。
【選項列表】A. bellicose  B. irenic  C. pugnacious  D. vitriolic
coreConcept: contrast to venomous diatribes... sought to reconcile warring factions 提示愛好和平促進和睦，選 irenic（和平主義的、促進和解的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 促進和平的和解的愛好和平的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「irenic」。和平和解高階形容詞選 irenic。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: The reviewer lauded the legal scholar for his dispassionate tone, noting that he weighed competing constitutional arguments with exemplary ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】書評專家對這位法學學者冷靜客觀、不偏不倚的超脫文風讚不絕口，高度盛讚他在權衡相互牴觸之憲法法理爭端時，展現出了堪稱典範的「平心靜氣/鎮定平穩的公正沉著」。
【選項列表】A. animosity  B. partisanship  C. equanimity  D. venom
coreConcept: dispassionate tone... weighed arguments with exemplary equanimity（平心靜氣的沉著公正）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 平靜鎮靜沉著心平氣和

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「equanimity」。心平氣和沉著冷靜名詞選 equanimity。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: The literary pamphlet was dismissed by scholars as mere ___ journalism, stuffed with salacious gossip designed exclusively to provoke public outrage and boost sales.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這本低俗文學小冊子被嚴謹的學者斥責為純粹的「黃色煽情」新聞炒作，通篇塞滿了繪聲繪色的低俗八卦小道消息，其唯一目的無非是意在煽動社會公眾的獵奇憤怒以瘋狂刺激銷量。
【選項列表】A. dispassionate  B. peer-reviewed  C. authoritative  D. yellow
coreConcept: salacious gossip designed to provoke outrage is yellow journalism（黃色煽情新聞）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 淫穢的好色的猥褻的淫蕩的
黃色的煽情的低級趣味的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「yellow」。黃色新聞固定搭配選 yellow journalism。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: The academic committee criticized the dissertation for its ___ style, lamenting that the candidate’s arrogant, pontificating prose alienated rather than persuaded the reader.
translation:
【題幹精譯】學術評審委員會對該博士論文那種居高臨下、不可一世的「傲慢專斷權威作態/頤指氣使的」文風提出了嚴厲指責，痛惜該候選人傲慢自大、以真理化身自居的說教措辭只會徹底疏遠激怒讀者，而非真正說服讀者。
【選項列表】A. magisterial  B. humble  C. deferential  D. tentative
coreConcept: arrogant, pontificating prose is imperious or overly magisterial（以學閥權威自居的傲慢）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 自以為是地發表高論說教
權威的威嚴的傲慢專斷的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「magisterial」。傲慢專斷形容詞選 magisterial。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: Rather than calmly refuting his opponent’s thesis with empirical counter-evidence, the debater resorted to personal ad hominem ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位辯論者並未耐心地運用實證反面數據冷靜駁斥對手的學術論點，反而墮落訴諸針對對手個人的訴諸人身攻擊與「惡毒破口謾罵」。
【選項列表】A. panegyric  B. invective  C. encomium  D. accolade
coreConcept: resorted to personal ad hominem invective/abuse（人身攻擊謾罵）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 訴諸人身的對人不對事的
謾罵猛烈抨擊惡毒言辭

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「invective」。謾罵痛斥名詞選 invective。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: The economic treatise was hailed as a model of rigorous scholarly inquiry, completely devoid of political partisanship or ideological ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這部經濟學專著被推崇為嚴謹學術探索的崇高典範，全書通篇完全擺脫了任何政黨黨派偏私色彩或僵化狂熱的意識形態「教條主義/獨斷盲從」。
【選項列表】A. open-mindedness  B. skepticism  C. dogmatism  D. tolerance
coreConcept: devoid of partisanship or ideological dogmatism（毫無黨派偏私與教條主義）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「dogmatism」。教條主義名詞選 dogmatism。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: The critic’s essay was essentially an extended ___, lamenting the perceived collapse of classical literary literacy in the digital smartphone age.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這篇文學批評隨筆本質上是一篇長篇大論、聲淚俱下的「悲嘆控訴文/悲歌檄文(jeremiad)」，對智慧型手機數位時代古典文學閱讀素養的所謂徹底崩潰淪喪發出了深沉無力的哀嘆與控訴。
【選項列表】A. eulogy  B. panegyric  C. tribute  D. jeremiad
coreConcept: extended lament for social decline is a jeremiad（悲嘆哀訴檄文）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 哀訴悲嘆長篇控訴文悲歌

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「jeremiad」。哀訴檄文專有名詞選 jeremiad。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: In his final retrospective interview, the retiring philosopher adopted a delightfully ___ stance, poking gentle fun at his own lifelong theoretical obsessions.
translation:
【題幹精譯】在退休前夕接受的最後一場深度回顧專訪中，這位德高望重的老哲學家展現出了一種令人如沐春風的「自我自嘲自謙的」灑脫從容姿態，極其幽默溫和地調侃打趣起自己畢生所執著著迷的那些理論玄思構想。
【選項列表】A. self-deprecating  B. grandiose  C. pompous  D. arrogant
coreConcept: poking gentle fun at himself is self-deprecating（自嘲謙遜的）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 自嘲的自我貶抑的過謙的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「self-deprecating」。幽默自嘲形容詞選 self-deprecating。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone
prompt: The revisionist biography was condemned for its reckless ___, tearing down established historical icons without providing credible archival documentation to substantiate its sensational claims.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這部標榜修正主義的人物傳記遭到了史學界的嚴厲痛斥，指責其充斥著輕率盲動、不負責任的「破除偶像狂熱/打倒傳統舊習之舉」，在毫無可信檔案實證支撐其聳人聽聞宣稱的情況下，肆意抹黑並推倒公認的歷史巨人雕像。
【選項列表】A. reverence  B. iconoclasm  C. orthodoxy  D. piety
coreConcept: tearing down icons without evidence is reckless iconoclasm（盲目的破除偶像主義）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 破除偶像打破舊習反傳統

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「iconoclasm」。打倒舊習專用名詞選 iconoclasm。

courseHook.unitTitle: Historiographical Polemics: Scholarly Tone 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: Post-colonial cultural geographers examine how members of the global diaspora negotiate hybrid identities, maintaining transnational kinship ties while resisting forced cultural ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】後殖民文化地理學家深入探討全球流散離散族群社群的成員如何建構與協調其多元雜揉的身分認同，在頑強維繫跨國親屬宗族血緣紐帶的同時，堅決抗拒被強迫實施的單一文化「同化/被強行同化消融」。
【選項列表】A. differentiation  B. emancipation  C. assimilation  D. liberation
coreConcept: resisting forced cultural assimilation（抗拒強制文化同化）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「assimilation」。文化同化名詞選 assimilation。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: Urban theorists utilize the concept of 'spatial justice' to criticize how municipal infrastructure investments disproportionately benefit affluent enclaves while systematically neglecting impoverished ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】現代城市批判理論家廣泛運用『空間正義』的激進學術概念，嚴厲抨擊市政公共基礎設施投資如何極度不成比例地偏袒傾斜於富裕白人封閉階層社區，而系統性地遺忘與拋棄城市底層貧困的「邊陲邊緣郊區地帶」。
【選項列表】A. palaces  B. citadels  C. mansions  D. peripheries
coreConcept: infrastructure benefits enclaves while neglecting impoverished peripheries（忽視貧困邊陲）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 飛地孤立聚居區封閉社區

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「peripheries」。邊陲郊區複數名詞選 peripheries。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: The rapid growth of post-war suburban tract housing was fueled by government-backed mortgages that engaged in systemic racial 'redlining,' enforcing residential ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】戰後西方郊區大批標準化成片集合住宅項目的野蠻瘋狂瘋長，很大程度上是由政府擔保的銀行房屋抵押貸款所暗中助推，後者長期推行系統性種族歧視性的『紅線劃定』政策，在法律和經濟上強制推行嚴格的居住空間「種族隔離」。
【選項列表】A. segregation  B. integration  C. amalgamation  D. cohesion
coreConcept: redlining enforces residential segregation（紅線政策強制居住隔離）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「segregation」。隔離分居名詞選 segregation。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: Human geographers define 'placelessness' as the erosion of unique geographical character, caused by the creeping standardization of global corporate franchise ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】人文地理學家將『無地方性/場所失落(placelessness)』嚴密定義為地理區域獨特地方特色與靈魂的徹底喪失淪喪，其根本禍根在於跨國連鎖企業標準化門市「建築格局外觀」在世界各地的鋪天蓋地野蠻擴張與同質化覆蓋。
【選項列表】A. botany  B. architecture  C. geology  D. meteorology
coreConcept: standardization of corporate franchise architecture causes placelessness。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 場所失落無地方性地域特徵喪失
建築學建築風格建築結構

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「architecture」。建築格局名詞選 architecture。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: The political geographer mapped trans-border migrant journeys across the Sonoran Desert, documenting how hostile border architecture turns nature itself into a lethal weapon of ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】這位政治地理學家繪製了無證跨境移民穿越索諾拉沙漠的生死遷徙路線圖，巨細靡遺詳實記錄了充滿敵意的邊境防禦工程設施如何將險惡酷熱的自然沙漠本身，活生生轉變成為了一種具有致命殺傷力的政治「威懾嚇阻/阻嚇驅逐」武器。
【選項列表】A. welcome  B. hospitality  C. deterrence  D. sanctuary
coreConcept: border architecture turns desert into a weapon of deterrence（威懾武器）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 敵意的敵對的艱困險惡的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「deterrence」。威懾嚇阻名詞選 deterrence。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: The 'right to the city,' a foundational concept formulated by Henri Lefebvre, demands that all urban inhabitants have an equitable voice in reshaping the metropolitan ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】由昂利·列斐伏爾所開創立論的『城市權(right to the city)』奠基性概念，大聲疾呼所有生活在城市中的居民大眾，無論貧富貴賤，在重新構建改造其身處之都會「生活空間環境/都市環境」的決策過程中，均應享有公正平等的實質話語權。
【選項列表】A. wilderness  B. glacier  C. stratosphere  D. environment
coreConcept: demands equitable voice in reshaping the metropolitan environment。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「environment」。都會環境名詞選 environment。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: The construction of transcontinental railways in the nineteenth century catalyzed the dramatic 'time-space ___,' compressing weeks of arduous travel into days.
translation:
【題幹精譯】十九世紀跨洲際橫貫鐵路幹線的相繼修築落成，強力催化引發了地理學上極具革命性的『時空「壓縮/時空壓縮效應(time-space compression)」』，將原先動輒耗費數週之久艱辛跋涉的漫長旅程，奇蹟般地大幅壓縮凝聚為短短數天之內即可抵達。
【選項列表】A. compression  B. expansion  C. stagnation  D. paralysis
coreConcept: Harvey's concept: time-space compression compresses travel time（時空壓縮）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「compression」。時空壓縮專有名詞選 compression。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: Cultural geographers emphasize that a 'landscape' is not merely an inert physical background, but an ideological text inscribed with layers of power, history, and social ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】文化地理學家反覆強調指出，所謂的『文化地景/景觀(landscape)』絕非一處死寂被動的客觀物理背景舞台，而是一篇鐫刻銘寫著錯綜複雜權力博弈、歷史沉積記憶以及深層社會文化「象徵意涵/多重意義」的意識形態文本。
【選項列表】A. erosion  B. meaning  C. geology  D. vacuum
coreConcept: landscape is an ideological text inscribed with social meaning。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 無活動力的惰性的呆滯的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「meaning」。社會意涵名詞選 meaning。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: Post-industrial cities have attempted to revitalize derelict manufacturing zones through 'flagship' cultural projects, hoping iconic architecture will stimulate urban ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】後工業時代的轉型城市紛紛試圖透過引進具有世界級震撼力的『旗艦型』指標文化工程項目，對荒廢廢棄的傳統老舊工廠重工業鏽帶街區進行活力重塑，寄望於憑藉標誌性明星建築的磁吸效應來強勢刺激都會「全面復興再生/都市更新振興」。
【選項列表】A. decay  B. collapse  C. regeneration  D. evacuation
coreConcept: iconic architecture stimulates urban regeneration/revitalization（都市再生）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 荒廢的被遺棄的破敗的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「regeneration」。都市復興再生名詞選 regeneration。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice
prompt: The phenomenon of 'environmental racism' describes how toxic waste repositories, incinerators, and polluting refineries are disproportionately sited in marginalized communities of ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】『環境種族主義』這一沉痛社會正義概念，揭露了各類有毒化學危險廢棄物掩埋場、大型垃圾焚化爐以及高污染石化煉油廠等高危嫌惡設施，在地理區位選址決策上，長期極度不成比例地被蓄意設置安插在邊緣化的弱勢有色人種「少數族裔/有色人種」底層社區周邊。
【選項列表】A. affluence  B. privilege  C. royalty  D. color
coreConcept: environmental racism sites waste facilities in communities of color。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「color」。有色人種社區專有名詞選 color（communities of color）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Cultural Geography: Diaspora & Spatial Justice 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: Socrates famously contrasted the authentic pursuit of truth in philosophical dialectic with the deceptive verbal trickery of professional ___ who sold rhetorical persuasion for coin.
translation:
【題幹精譯】蘇格拉底著名地將哲學辨證法中對宇宙客觀客觀真理的純粹誠摯求索，與那些收費講學、專門向青年兜售巧言令色辯論騙術的職業「詭辯家/智者派詭辯學者」充滿欺騙性的小聰明言辭把戲進行了嚴厲而鮮明的對比。
【選項列表】A. sophists  B. hermits  C. martyrs  D. ascetics
coreConcept: contrasted philosophical dialectic with deceptive trickery of sophists。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「sophists」。智者派詭辯家名詞選 sophists。

courseHook.unitTitle: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: In classical Aristotelian logic, a standard categorical ___ consists of two premises—a major premise and a minor premise—from which a necessary conclusion is formally deduced.
translation:
【題幹精譯】在亞里斯多德古典演繹邏輯體系中，一個標準的直言命題「三段論/三段推論法(syllogism)」由兩個核心前提——即一個大前提與一個小前提——所精確構成，由此出發，一個在形式邏輯上具備必然有效性的結論便可被必然演繹推導而出。
【選項列表】A. tautology  B. syllogism  C. paradox  D. euphemism
coreConcept: two premises and a conclusion form a syllogism（三段論）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 三段論三段推論演繹推理

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「syllogism」。演繹三段論核心名詞選 syllogism。

courseHook.unitTitle: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: An 'enthymeme' in classical rhetoric is an abbreviated syllogism in which one of the foundational premises is left ___ because it is assumed to be common knowledge.
translation:
【題幹精譯】古典修辭學中的『省略三段論/省略推理法(enthymeme)』，是一種將基礎前提之一刻意保持「未直接言明/省略不提」的精簡壓縮論證結構，因為該前提已被預設為全體聽眾心照不宣的普遍常識公理。
【選項列表】A. disproved  B. celebrated  C. unstated  D. condemned
coreConcept: enthymeme leaves one premise unstated/implicit（前提省略不言自明）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 省略三段論隱前提論證
未說明的未直接表達的隱含的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「unstated」。未說明的形容詞選 unstated。

courseHook.unitTitle: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: The prosecutor exposed the defense counsel's argument as a blatant 'straw man' fallacy: distorting the prosecution's claim to make it artificially vulnerable to ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】檢察官在法庭上當庭狠狠戳穿了辯護律師論點純屬一場徹頭徹尾、漏洞百出的『稻草人謬誤』：即刻意曲解並誇張化檢方的真正起訴主張，使其顯得極度荒謬可笑，進而極其容易被「駁斥反駁/推翻擊垮」。
【選項列表】A. endorsement  B. admiration  C. ratification  D. refutation
coreConcept: straw man distorts claim to make it vulnerable to refutation（稻草人謬誤便於駁斥）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。

vocabulary.meaning: 公然的明目張膽的赤裸裸的

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「refutation」。駁斥反駁名詞選 refutation。

courseHook.unitTitle: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: In his philosophical dialogues, Plato depicted the Socratic method as a form of intellectual 'midwifery' (*maieutics*), helping interlocutors give birth to latent ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】在其傳世哲學對話錄中，柏拉圖將蘇格拉底問答法生動描摹比喻為一種精神智力層面上的『精神助產術(*maieutics*)』，其崇高使命在於悉心協助對話者自身在思考探索中，順利『分娩誕育』出原本深藏於其靈魂深處之潛在「真理理念/本質認知」。
【選項列表】A. truths  B. delusions  C. crimes  D. debts
coreConcept: Socratic maieutics helps interlocutors give birth to latent truths（精神助產術催生真理）。
sentenceAnalysis: GRE Verbal 典型高階學術思維句型：強調嚴密修辭邊界、上下文語意連貫度與深層實證邏輯支持。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「truths」。真理理念名詞選 truths。

subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: The defense brief was criticized for committing the fallacy of 'begging the question,' circular reasoning in which the premise presupposes the truth of the very ___ it seeks to prove.
translation:
【題幹精譯】該辯護訴狀遭到了主審法官的嚴厲訓誡批評，斥責其犯下了荒謬的『乞題/預先假設證明對象』之典型循環論證邏輯謬誤，在該謬誤中，其立論前提竟厚顏無恥地預先直接假定了其原本想要費力證明的那個「最終結論」本身是真實不虛的。

結論推論推導出之結果

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: Aristotle's *Rhetoric* categorizes the modes of persuasion into three foundational appeals: *logos* (logic), *pathos* (emotion), and *ethos* (the speaker's moral ___).

【題幹精譯】亞里斯多德在《修辭學》巨著中將古典雄辯說服的三大核心要素劃分為三個奠基性維度：*logos*（理智論證邏輯）、*pathos*（感官情緒喚起）以及 *ethos*（演說者自身所具備之道德「品格人格魅力/聲譽操守」）。
【選項列表】A. wealth  B. appearance  C. character  D. ancestry
coreConcept: ethos appeals to the speaker's moral character/credibility（講者道德品格）。

courseHook.unitTitle: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: The debater accused his opponent of creating a 'false dichotomy,' artificially reducing a complex multidimensional spectrum of economic policy options to two extreme, mutually exclusive ___.

【題幹精譯】辯手在場上義正言辭地指控其對手刻意炮製製造了荒唐的『假兩難/假二分法謬誤』，不負責任地將極其複雜多元、富有廣泛漸進過渡光譜的宏觀經濟政策政策選項，人為粗暴地強行閹割簡化為兩個非黑即白、極端對立且相互排他的「絕不兩立的替代方案」。
【選項列表】A. consensuses  B. harmonies  C. syntheses  D. alternatives
coreConcept: false dichotomy reduces options to two mutually exclusive alternatives（假兩難極端選項）。

vocabulary.meaning: 二分法二元對立兩難分支

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「alternatives」。替代方案複數名詞選 alternatives。

courseHook.unitTitle: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: Plato’s *Gorgias* condemns the art of rhetoric when detached from virtue as a form of deceptive 'flattery,' comparing it to cookery that pleases the palate while corrupting the ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】柏拉圖在其傳世名篇《高爾吉亞篇》中，對脫離了道德美德良知的修辭雄辯術予以了無情痛斥，將其定性為一種欺世盜名的下賤『諂媚逢迎術』，刻薄地將其比擬為只知討好挑逗人類舌尖味蕾、卻在暗中瘋狂腐蝕毒化人類「靈魂精神」的低級烹飪之術。
【選項列表】A. soul  B. appetite  C. tongue  D. teeth
coreConcept: rhetoric without virtue corrupts the soul like cookery corrupts body/soul。

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「soul」。靈魂名詞選 soul。

courseHook.unitTitle: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 7: GRE Verbal 語意邏輯 (GRE C1~C2)
subtopic: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry
prompt: The Roman orator Cicero argued that the ideal statesman must unite intense philosophical erudition with masterly eloquence, asserting that wisdom without speech is politically ___.
translation:
【題幹精譯】古羅馬最偉大的雄辯家與政治家西塞羅在其經典著作中雄辯地論證指出，理想的政治領袖必須將深厚的哲學博學多識與爐火純青的大師級雄辯才華融為一爐，斷言指出：倘若唯有空泛深奧之智慧而缺乏感染公眾之言辭口才，在政治實踐中無異於陷入徹底的「軟弱無能/毫無力量束手無策」。
【選項列表】A. omnipotent  B. impotent  C. triumphant  D. flourishing
coreConcept: Cicero: wisdom without eloquence is politically impotent/powerless。

vocabulary.meaning: 無能為力的軟弱無力的虛弱的

courseHook.unitTitle: Classical Rhetoric: Dialectic & Sophistry 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 8: GMAT Focus 商業邏輯 (GMAT C2+)
subtopic: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
prompt: A municipal transit agency introduced express bus lanes on major arteries and observed a twenty percent increase in ridership over six months. The director concluded that dedicating lanes exclusively to buses directly caused commuters to abandon private automobiles. Which of the following is an assumption required by the director's argument?
options: Private automobile registrations in the municipality decreased by exactly twenty percent over the six months.
Bus fares were doubled immediately following the installation of the dedicated express lanes.
The surge in bus ridership was not primarily driven by an influx of new residents or fuel price spikes occurring during the same period.
The express bus routes experienced zero mechanical breakdowns throughout the evaluation period.
translation:
【題幹精譯與邏輯分析】辨識必要假設：論點認為『專用道直接導致通勤者棄私家車搭公車』。因果結論必須排除其他外生混雜變數（如人口湧入或油價暴漲亦能暴增搭乘人數），故假設『該增幅並非主要由同時期的新增居民湧入或油價飆升所驅動』是該論證成立的必備假設。
【選項列表】A. Private automobile registrations in the municipality decreased by exactly twenty percent over the six months.  B. Bus fares were doubled immediately following the installation of the dedicated express lanes.  C. The surge in bus ridership was not primarily driven by an influx of new residents or fuel price spikes occurring during the same period.  D. The express bus routes experienced zero mechanical breakdowns throughout the evaluation period.
coreConcept: GMAT 核心題型：排除外生因果混雜變數 (Alternative Causes)。
sentenceAnalysis: GMAT Focus 批判推理高階商業思維模型：要求嚴密辨識論點隱含前提 (Suppressed Premises)、因果混雜變數與量價/經濟學權衡機制。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「The surge in bus ridership was not primarily driven by an influx of new residents or fuel price spikes occurring during the same period.」。GMAT 核心題型：排除外生因果混雜變數 (Alternative Causes)。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

courseHook.unitTitle: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 8: GMAT Focus 商業邏輯 (GMAT C2+)
subtopic: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
prompt: A retail chain eliminated paper coupons and shifted its entire promotional budget to smartphone app notifications, subsequently recording record quarterly sales. The marketing VP asserted that app notifications are far more effective at stimulating consumer purchases than print media. Which assumption underlies this conclusion?
options: The retailer's competitor declared bankruptcy during the same quarter.
Smartphone ownership among the retailer's customers reached one hundred percent.
Print coupons cost twice as much to distribute as digital notifications.
Customers who made purchases through the app would not have spent an equal or greater amount had print coupons been retained alongside the app.
translation:
【題幹精譯與邏輯分析】辨識必要假設：副總裁斷言『App 通知比紙本優惠券更有效拉抬消費』。必須假設『若保留紙本優惠券，這些消費者的消費額不會等於或超過使用 App 時的消費額』，否則無法證明 App 相對更有效。
【選項列表】A. The retailer's competitor declared bankruptcy during the same quarter.  B. Smartphone ownership among the retailer's customers reached one hundred percent.  C. Print coupons cost twice as much to distribute as digital notifications.  D. Customers who made purchases through the app would not have spent an equal or greater amount had print coupons been retained alongside the app.
coreConcept: 否定檢驗法 (Negation Test)：若紙本帶來更多消費，則結論被擊潰。
sentenceAnalysis: GMAT Focus 批判推理高階商業思維模型：要求嚴密辨識論點隱含前提 (Suppressed Premises)、因果混雜變數與量價/經濟學權衡機制。

vocabulary.meaning: 作為…的基礎構成…的根基

trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「Customers who made purchases through the app would not have spent an equal or greater amount had print coupons been retained alongside the app.」。否定檢驗法 (Negation Test)：若紙本帶來更多消費，則結論被擊潰。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

courseHook.unitTitle: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 8: GMAT Focus 商業邏輯 (GMAT C2+)
subtopic: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
prompt: A manufacturing corporation installed ergonomic chairs and standing desks across its headquarters and subsequently observed a fifteen percent drop in employee absenteeism. Management concluded that ergonomic furniture directly improved employee physical health, thereby reducing sick leave. Which assumption is required?
options: The decline in absenteeism was not primarily attributable to a newly implemented remote-work policy enacted at the same time.
Every employee used the standing function of their desk for at least four hours daily.
The cost of the ergonomic furniture was completely offset by productivity gains within six months.
Absenteeism rates in competing firms increased over the same chronological timeframe.
translation:
【題幹精譯與邏輯分析】必要假設題：管理層認定人體工學家具直接減少了生病請假。必須排除同時實施的遠距辦公政策等其他重大混雜變數（排除他因）。
【選項列表】A. The decline in absenteeism was not primarily attributable to a newly implemented remote-work policy enacted at the same time.  B. Every employee used the standing function of their desk for at least four hours daily.  C. The cost of the ergonomic furniture was completely offset by productivity gains within six months.  D. Absenteeism rates in competing firms increased over the same chronological timeframe.
coreConcept: 因果歸因必要假設：排除同時發生的重大干擾政策。
sentenceAnalysis: GMAT Focus 批判推理高階商業思維模型：要求嚴密辨識論點隱含前提 (Suppressed Premises)、因果混雜變數與量價/經濟學權衡機制。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (A)「The decline in absenteeism was not primarily attributable to a newly implemented remote-work policy enacted at the same time.」。因果歸因必要假設：排除同時發生的重大干擾政策。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

courseHook.unitTitle: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 8: GMAT Focus 商業邏輯 (GMAT C2+)
subtopic: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
prompt: A regional hospital mandated that all surgeons complete a ten-minute mindfulness meditation prior to entering the operating theater, resulting in a thirty percent reduction in postoperative surgical complications. The chief of surgery concluded that surgeon meditation directly enhances surgical precision. Which assumption is necessary?
options: Surgeons who meditated slept an average of two hours longer each night.
The complexity and risk profile of the surgical procedures performed remained comparable before and after the mindfulness mandate.
Postoperative complications were entirely eradicated following the introduction of the policy.
Patients were informed of their surgeon's meditation practice prior to anesthesia.
translation:
【題幹精譯與邏輯分析】必要假設題：結論認為冥想提高精準度降低併發症。必要假設是：手術的複雜度與風險程度在政策實施前後是相當的（若後續只接簡單手術，則併發症減少不能歸因於冥想）。
【選項列表】A. Surgeons who meditated slept an average of two hours longer each night.  B. The complexity and risk profile of the surgical procedures performed remained comparable before and after the mindfulness mandate.  C. Postoperative complications were entirely eradicated following the introduction of the policy.  D. Patients were informed of their surgeon's meditation practice prior to anesthesia.
coreConcept: 控制變數假設：手術難度維持相當 (comparable complexity)。
sentenceAnalysis: GMAT Focus 批判推理高階商業思維模型：要求嚴密辨識論點隱含前提 (Suppressed Premises)、因果混雜變數與量價/經濟學權衡機制。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (B)「The complexity and risk profile of the surgical procedures performed remained comparable before and after the mindfulness mandate.」。控制變數假設：手術難度維持相當 (comparable complexity)。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

courseHook.unitTitle: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 8: GMAT Focus 商業邏輯 (GMAT C2+)
subtopic: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
prompt: An airline replaced hot meal service with pre-packaged snack boxes on short-haul flights and saw customer satisfaction scores increase by eight points. The executive concluded that passengers prefer light snacks over elaborate hot meals. What does this argument assume?
options: Snack boxes cost the airline forty percent less to provision than hot catering.
Every passenger on short-haul flights consumed the entirety of their snack box.
The increase in satisfaction scores was not caused by significant improvements in flight punctuality during the trial.
Hot meals will be permanently discontinued across all transcontinental international routes.
translation:
【題幹精譯與邏輯分析】必要假設題：高管將滿意度上升歸因於輕食點心盒。必須排除航班準點率大幅提升等其他真正導致滿意度暴增的決定性因素。
【選項列表】A. Snack boxes cost the airline forty percent less to provision than hot catering.  B. Every passenger on short-haul flights consumed the entirety of their snack box.  C. The increase in satisfaction scores was not caused by significant improvements in flight punctuality during the trial.  D. Hot meals will be permanently discontinued across all transcontinental international routes.
coreConcept: 排除他因假設：滿意度上升並非由準點率改善所致。
sentenceAnalysis: GMAT Focus 批判推理高階商業思維模型：要求嚴密辨識論點隱含前提 (Suppressed Premises)、因果混雜變數與量價/經濟學權衡機制。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (C)「The increase in satisfaction scores was not caused by significant improvements in flight punctuality during the trial.」。排除他因假設：滿意度上升並非由準點率改善所致。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

courseHook.unitTitle: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 8: GMAT Focus 商業邏輯 (GMAT C2+)
subtopic: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
prompt: A tech enterprise switched from annual performance evaluations to continuous weekly feedback sessions, observing a twenty-five percent increase in software deployment frequency. Leadership inferred that continuous feedback directly accelerated developer output. Which assumption is required?

Developers worked forty percent more overtime hours following the policy change.
Software bug density doubled as a consequence of faster deployments.
The increased deployment frequency was not the result of breaking software updates into smaller, more frequent increments.

【選項列表】A. Annual reviews caused severe psychological distress among all engineering staff.  B. Developers worked forty percent more overtime hours following the policy change.  C. Software bug density doubled as a consequence of faster deployments.  D. The increased deployment frequency was not the result of breaking software updates into smaller, more frequent increments.
coreConcept: 排除測量口徑改變之他因：非因拆小更新所致。
sentenceAnalysis: GMAT Focus 批判推理高階商業思維模型：要求嚴密辨識論點隱含前提 (Suppressed Premises)、因果混雜變數與量價/經濟學權衡機制。
trapExplanation: 【選項剖析】正確答案為 (D)「The increased deployment frequency was not the result of breaking software updates into smaller, more frequent increments.」。排除測量口徑改變之他因：非因拆小更新所致。 此項精準鎖定核心邏輯因果關係，其餘干擾選項若非偏離討論範疇 (Out of Scope)，即為混淆充分與必要條件、或反向削弱/支持。

subtopic: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
prompt: A university library replaced desktop computers with individual study carrels equipped with power outlets, and student visits increased by fifty percent. The head librarian concluded that students prioritize quiet laptop charging spaces over shared computing terminals. What assumption is necessary?

Desktop computers were completely obsolete and incapable of browsing the internet.
Students spend an average of six consecutive hours studying in the library daily.
University tuition was reduced following the removal of the desktop computers.

University tuition was reduced following the removal of the desktop computers.

courseHook.unitTitle: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises 核心微課

tierLabel: Level 8: GMAT Focus 商業邏輯 (GMAT C2+)
subtopic: Identify the Assumption: Causal Premises
prompt: A logistics firm mandated that delivery drivers follow GPS algorithms that avoid left turns across oncoming traffic, subsequently noting a twelve percent drop in fuel consumption. The fleet director argued that minimizing idling at left turns was the primary driver of fuel efficiency. What does this argument assume?
options: Fleet maintenance costs increased by fifteen percent due to transmission wear.
Drivers did not substantially reduce their highway driving speeds during the test period.
Left turns are responsible for ninety percent of all municipal traffic collisions.
The algorithm increased the total mileage driven per delivery route by fifty miles.
translation:

subtopic: Flaw in the Reasoning: Post Hoc Fallacy
prompt: A patient began taking daily garlic supplements and noted that her chronic arthritis pain vanished three weeks later. It draws an inference based on the assumption that what is true of a part of the body is necessarily true of the whole.
It treats a condition that is sufficient to alleviate pain as one that is necessary for doing so.
It concludes that the garlic caused the improvement merely because the improvement occurred after the garlic was consumed, ignoring the cyclical nature of chronic arthritis flare-ups.

【選項列表】A. It attacks the personal integrity of pharmaceutical rheumatologists rather than addressing their clinical data.  B. It draws an inference based on the assumption that what is true of a part of the body is necessarily true of the whole.  C. It treats a condition that is sufficient to alleviate pain as one that is necessary for doing so.  D. It concludes that the garlic caused the improvement merely because the improvement occurred after the garlic was consumed, ignoring the cyclical nature of chronic arthritis flare-ups.
coreConcept: 忽視疾病自發週期，將時間後續錯當因果。

It assumes that academic tenure has been completely abolished across peer research universities.

The temperature inside the reactor did not drop below 180 degrees Celsius during the production of this batch.  D. Brittle plastic polymers can be recycled into high-grade automotive bumpers.

Browse vegetation grew more rapidly due to increased nitrogen deposition from wolf excretions.

Hospital B specialized in outpatient cosmetic dental procedures.
The average length of patient hospitalization at Hospital A was three days.

coreConcept: 基數差異謬誤：絕對感染數不能代表真實感染率 (Infection Rate)。

prompt: An enterprise SaaS software vendor doubled the annual subscription price for its flagship CRM platform. Total annual subscription revenue increased by fifty percent because the seventy-five percent of clients who remained each paid double the original price.  C. Competing CRM software platforms experienced minor server latency downtime during the third quarter.  D. The vendor's chief marketing officer presented a keynote speech at a major technology summit.
coreConcept: SaaS 軟體定價權思維：高留存客戶帶來的溢價大幅超過少數流失客戶。
sentenceAnalysis: GMAT Focus 批判推理高階商業思維模型：要求嚴密辨識論點隱含前提 (Suppressed Premises)、因果混雜變數與量價/經濟學權衡機制。
